from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.application.announcements.approval.async_approval_service import (
    AsyncAnnouncementPublicationApprovalService,
)


AdminAuthorizer = Callable[[], Awaitable[bool]]


class PublicationApprovalRequest(BaseModel):
    actor: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=255)


class PublicationApprovalResponse(BaseModel):
    publication_id: str
    status: str
    approved_at: str | None


async def _default_admin_authorizer() -> bool:
    return False


def create_announcement_operations_approval_router(
    *,
    approval_service: AsyncAnnouncementPublicationApprovalService,
    admin_authorizer: AdminAuthorizer = _default_admin_authorizer,
) -> APIRouter:
    if approval_service is None:
        raise ValueError("approval_service cannot be None.")
    if admin_authorizer is None:
        raise ValueError("admin_authorizer cannot be None.")

    router = APIRouter(
        prefix="/api/announcement-operations",
        tags=["announcement-operations"],
    )

    async def require_admin() -> None:
        try:
            authorized = await admin_authorizer()
        except Exception:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
                detail="Administrator authorization required.",
            ) from None

        if not authorized:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
                detail="Administrator authorization required.",
            )

    @router.post(
        "/publications/{publication_id}/approve",
        response_model=PublicationApprovalResponse,
        status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK,
        dependencies=[Depends(require_admin)],
    )
    async def approve_publication(
        publication_id: str,
        request: PublicationApprovalRequest,
    ) -> PublicationApprovalResponse:
        try:
            result = await approval_service.approve(
                publication_id=publication_id,
                actor=request.actor,
            )
        except LookupError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
                detail=str(exc),
            ) from exc
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                detail=str(exc),
            ) from exc

        publication = result.publication
        return PublicationApprovalResponse(
            publication_id=publication.publication_id,
            status=publication.status.value,
            approved_at=(
                publication.approved_at.isoformat()
                if publication.approved_at is not None
                else None
            ),

from __future__ import annotations

from .announcement_policy import AnnouncementPolicy
from .models import Announcement, AnnouncementType, ComposedAnnouncement


_TYPE_LABELS: dict[AnnouncementType, str] = {
    AnnouncementType.NEW_FEATURE: "ðŸš€ NEW FEATURE",
    AnnouncementType.MAINTENANCE: "ðŸ› ï¸ MAINTENANCE",
    AnnouncementType.KNOWN_ISSUE: "ðŸ› KNOWN ISSUE",
    AnnouncementType.INCIDENT: "ðŸš¨ INCIDENT",
    AnnouncementType.PLANNED_DOWNTIME: "ðŸ• PLANNED DOWNTIME",
    AnnouncementType.IMPORTANT: "ðŸ“¢ IMPORTANT",
    AnnouncementType.BETA_TEST: "ðŸ§ª BETA TEST",
    AnnouncementType.FEEDBACK: "ðŸ’¬ FEEDBACK",
    AnnouncementType.PRIVACY: "ðŸ” PRIVACY",
    AnnouncementType.POLICY: "ðŸ“œ POLICY",
    AnnouncementType.BETA_UPDATE: "ðŸŽ“ BETA UPDATE",
    AnnouncementType.OTHER: "ðŸ“Œ UPDATE",
}


class AnnouncementComposer:
    """Creates validated, consistent EasyWorld announcement messages."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        policy: AnnouncementPolicy | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._policy = policy or AnnouncementPolicy()

    def compose(
        self,
        *,
        announcement_type: AnnouncementType,
        title: str,
        body: str,
        footer: str | None = None,
    ) -> ComposedAnnouncement:
        announcement = Announcement(
            announcement_type=announcement_type,
            title=title,
            body=body,
            footer=footer,
        )

        self._policy.validate(announcement)

        parts = [
            _TYPE_LABELS[announcement_type],
            "",
            f"**{announcement.title.strip()}**",
            "",
            announcement.body.strip(),
        ]

        if announcement.footer:
            parts.extend(["", announcement.footer.strip()])

        parts.extend(["", "ðŸŒ± *EasyWorld â€” Growing with You*"])

        return ComposedAnnouncement(
            announcement=announcement,
            rendered_text="\n".join(parts),
        )

from __future__ import annotations

from .models import Announcement


class AnnouncementPolicyError(ValueError):
    """Raised when an announcement violates publication policy."""


class AnnouncementPolicy:
    """Beta 1 validation boundary for administrator-controlled announcements."""

    MAX_TITLE_LENGTH = 120
    MAX_BODY_LENGTH = 1800
    MAX_FOOTER_LENGTH = 300

    def validate(self, announcement: Announcement) -> None:
        if not announcement.title.strip():
            raise AnnouncementPolicyError("Announcement title is required.")

        if not announcement.body.strip():
            raise AnnouncementPolicyError("Announcement body is required.")

        if len(announcement.title) > self.MAX_TITLE_LENGTH:
            raise AnnouncementPolicyError(
                "Announcement title exceeds the Beta 1 limit."
            )

        if len(announcement.body) > self.MAX_BODY_LENGTH:
            raise AnnouncementPolicyError(
                "Announcement body exceeds the Beta 1 limit."
            )

        if (
            announcement.footer is not None
            and len(announcement.footer) > self.MAX_FOOTER_LENGTH
        ):
            raise AnnouncementPolicyError(
                "Announcement footer exceeds the Beta 1 limit."
            )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Protocol


class AnnouncementPublisher(Protocol):
    async def publish(
        self,
        *,
        channel_id: str,
        text: str,
    ) -> str:
        """Publish an announcement and return its external message ID."""


class PublicationDisabledError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised when controlled announcement publishing is disabled."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PublicationRecord:
    channel_id: str
    message_id: str
    announcement_type: str
    published_at: datetime


class ControlledAnnouncementPublisher:
    """Application boundary enforcing the explicit Beta 1 publication switch."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        publisher: AnnouncementPublisher,
        publishing_enabled: bool,
    ) -> None:
        if publisher is None:
            raise ValueError("publisher cannot be None.")

        self._publisher = publisher
        self._publishing_enabled = publishing_enabled

    async def publish(
        self,
        *,
        channel_id: str,
        text: str,
        announcement_type: str,
    ) -> PublicationRecord:
        if not self._publishing_enabled:
            raise PublicationDisabledError(
                "Telegram announcement publishing is disabled."
            )

        message_id = await self._publisher.publish(
            channel_id=channel_id,
            text=text,
        )

        return PublicationRecord(
            channel_id=channel_id,
            message_id=message_id,
            announcement_type=announcement_type,
            published_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        )

"""WS-22.3.1 provider/channel-independent ports."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Protocol

from app.domain.announcement_publication.execution import (
    PublishAnnouncementCommand,
    PublicationExecutionResult,
)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PublicationForExecution:
    """Minimal execution projection required by the use case.

    The adapter/application layer can map the existing WS-22.1
    publication model into this projection without coupling the execution
    engine to a specific channel provider.
    """

    publication_id: str
    status: str
    destination: str
    rendered_content: str


class PublicationExecutionRepository(Protocol):
    """Port for loading and recording publication execution state."""

    async def get_for_execution(
        self,
        publication_id: str,
    ) -> PublicationForExecution | None:
        ...

    async def record_execution(
        self,
        result: PublicationExecutionResult,
    ) -> None:
        ...


class PublicationPublisher(Protocol):
    """Provider/channel-neutral publishing port."""

    async def publish(
        self,
        *,
        publication: PublicationForExecution,
        idempotency_key: str,
    ) -> str:
        """Publish and return an opaque provider reference.

        Implementations must not expose credentials through the result.
        """
        ...


class PublicationAuditSink(Protocol):
    """Port for durable/observable publication audit events."""

    async def record(self, event: object) -> None:
        ...


class PublicationIdempotencyStore(Protocol):
    """Port preventing duplicate external publication attempts."""

    async def get_result(
        self,
        idempotency_key: str,
    ) -> PublicationExecutionResult | None:
        ...

    async def store_result(
        self,
        result: PublicationExecutionResult,
    ) -> None:
        ...


__all__ = [
    "PublicationAuditSink",
    "PublicationExecutionRepository",
    "PublicationExecutionResult",
    "PublicationForExecution",
    "PublicationIdempotencyStore",
    "PublicationPublisher",
]


FILE: C:\AI Folder\EasyChatBot-Hackathon\backend\app\application\announcement_operations\publication_execution_service.py
"""WS-22.3.1 publication execution application contract."""

from __future__ import annotations

from app.application.announcement_operations.publication_execution_ports import (
    PublicationAuditSink,
    PublicationExecutionRepository,
    PublicationIdempotencyStore,
    PublicationPublisher,
)
from app.domain.announcement_publication.execution import (
    PublishAnnouncementCommand,
    PublicationAuditEvent,
    PublicationExecutionErrorCode,
    PublicationExecutionResult,
)


class PublicationExecutionService:
    """Execute an approved publication through an injected publishing port.

    This service contains orchestration only. It does not know Telegram,
    HTTP, frontend concerns, credentials, or provider-specific APIs.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        repository: PublicationExecutionRepository,
        publisher: PublicationPublisher,
        idempotency_store: PublicationIdempotencyStore,
        audit_sink: PublicationAuditSink,
    ) -> None:
        if any(
            dependency is None
            for dependency in (
                repository,
                publisher,
                idempotency_store,
                audit_sink,
            )
        ):
            raise ValueError("All publication execution dependencies are required.")

        self._repository = repository
        self._publisher = publisher
        self._idempotency_store = idempotency_store
        self._audit_sink = audit_sink

    async def execute(
        self,
        command: PublishAnnouncementCommand,
    ) -> PublicationExecutionResult:
        """Execute one explicit publication request."""

        existing = await self._idempotency_store.get_result(
            command.idempotency_key
        )
        if existing is not None:
            return existing

        publication = await self._repository.get_for_execution(
            command.publication_id
        )

        if publication is None:
            result = PublicationExecutionResult.failed(
                publication_id=command.publication_id,
                idempotency_key=command.idempotency_key,
                error_code=PublicationExecutionErrorCode.INVALID_STATE,
                error_message="Publication is not available for execution.",
            )
            await self._record_result(command, result)
            return result

        if publication.status.lower() not in {"approved", "ready_to_publish"}:
            result = PublicationExecutionResult.failed(
                publication_id=command.publication_id,
                idempotency_key=command.idempotency_key,
                error_code=PublicationExecutionErrorCode.INVALID_STATE,
                error_message="Publication is not in an executable state.",
            )
            await self._record_result(command, result)
            return result

        try:
            provider_reference = await self._publisher.publish(
                publication=publication,
                idempotency_key=command.idempotency_key,
            )
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            result = PublicationExecutionResult.failed(
                publication_id=command.publication_id,
                idempotency_key=command.idempotency_key,
                error_code=PublicationExecutionErrorCode.PROVIDER_ERROR,
                error_message=str(exc) or "Publication provider failed.",
            )
            await self._record_result(command, result)
            return result

        result = PublicationExecutionResult.succeeded(
            publication_id=command.publication_id,
            idempotency_key=command.idempotency_key,
            provider_reference=provider_reference,
        )
        await self._record_result(command, result)
        return result

    async def _record_result(
        self,
        command: PublishAnnouncementCommand,
        result: PublicationExecutionResult,
    ) -> None:
        await self._idempotency_store.store_result(result)
        await self._repository.record_execution(result)

        await self._audit_sink.record(
            PublicationAuditEvent(
                event_name="announcement_publication_execution",
                publication_id=result.publication_id,
                requested_by=command.requested_by,
                status=result.status,
                occurred_at=result.executed_at,
                idempotency_key=result.idempotency_key,
                provider_reference=result.provider_reference,
                error_code=result.error_code,
                safe_metadata={"execution_status": result.status.value},
            )
        )


__all__ = ["PublicationExecutionService"]

"""Application service for controlled Announcement Operations lifecycle."""
from __future__ import annotations

from uuid import UUID, uuid4

from app.domain.announcements.announcement import Announcement
from app.domain.announcements.publication_event import PublicationEvent, PublicationEventType
from .announcement_repository import AnnouncementRepository
from .publication_event_repository import PublicationEventRepository


class AnnouncementOperationsService:
    """Coordinates lifecycle changes and immutable audit events.

    This foundation intentionally does not deliver to Telegram. Delivery is a
    later adapter behind an explicit port so the domain remains provider-independent.
    """

    def __init__(self, *, repository: AnnouncementRepository, event_repository: PublicationEventRepository) -> None:
        self._repository = repository
        self._events = event_repository

    async def create(self, *, title: str, body: str, actor: str, correlation_id: str | None = None) -> Announcement:
        if not title.strip() or not body.strip() or not actor.strip():
            raise ValueError("title, body and actor are required.")
        announcement = Announcement(title=title.strip(), body=body.strip(), created_by=actor.strip())
        await self._repository.save(announcement)
        await self._audit(announcement, PublicationEventType.CREATED, actor, correlation_id)
        return announcement

    async def mark_ready_for_review(self, announcement_id: UUID, *, actor: str, correlation_id: str | None = None) -> Announcement:
        announcement = await self._require(announcement_id)
        announcement.mark_ready_for_review()
        await self._repository.save(announcement)
        await self._audit(announcement, PublicationEventType.READY_FOR_REVIEW, actor, correlation_id)
        return announcement

    async def approve(self, announcement_id: UUID, *, actor: str, correlation_id: str | None = None) -> Announcement:
        announcement = await self._require(announcement_id)
        announcement.approve(actor)
        await self._repository.save(announcement)
        await self._audit(announcement, PublicationEventType.APPROVED, actor, correlation_id)
        return announcement

    async def request_publication(self, announcement_id: UUID, *, actor: str, correlation_id: str | None = None) -> Announcement:
        announcement = await self._require(announcement_id)
        announcement.request_publication()
        await self._repository.save(announcement)
        await self._audit(announcement, PublicationEventType.PUBLISH_REQUESTED, actor, correlation_id)
        return announcement

    async def mark_published(self, announcement_id: UUID, *, actor: str, correlation_id: str | None = None, provider_message_id: str | None = None) -> Announcement:
        announcement = await self._require(announcement_id)
        announcement.mark_published()
        await self._repository.save(announcement)
        await self._audit(announcement, PublicationEventType.PUBLISHED, actor, correlation_id, provider_message_id=provider_message_id)
        return announcement

    async def mark_failed(self, announcement_id: UUID, *, actor: str, error_code: str, correlation_id: str | None = None) -> Announcement:
        announcement = await self._require(announcement_id)
        announcement.mark_failed()
        await self._repository.save(announcement)
        await self._audit(announcement, PublicationEventType.FAILED, actor, correlation_id, error_code=error_code)
        return announcement

    async def get(self, announcement_id: UUID) -> Announcement:
        return await self._require(announcement_id)

    async def list(self) -> tuple[Announcement, ...]:
        return await self._repository.list()

    async def audit_log(self, announcement_id: UUID) -> tuple[PublicationEvent, ...]:
        await self._require(announcement_id)
        return await self._events.list_for_publication(announcement_id)

    async def _require(self, announcement_id: UUID) -> Announcement:
        announcement = await self._repository.get(announcement_id)
        if announcement is None:
            raise LookupError(f"Announcement {announcement_id} was not found.")
        return announcement

    async def _audit(self, announcement: Announcement, event_type: PublicationEventType, actor: str, correlation_id: str | None, *, error_code: str | None = None, provider_message_id: str | None = None) -> None:
        if not actor.strip():
            raise ValueError("actor cannot be empty.")
        await self._events.append(PublicationEvent(
            publication_id=announcement.id,
            event_type=event_type,
            actor=actor,
            correlation_id=correlation_id or str(uuid4()),
            error_code=error_code,
            provider_message_id=provider_message_id,
        ))

"""Repository port for Announcement Operations."""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Protocol
from uuid import UUID

from app.domain.announcements.announcement import Announcement


class AnnouncementRepository(Protocol):
    async def save(self, announcement: Announcement) -> Announcement: ...
    async def get(self, announcement_id: UUID) -> Announcement | None: ...
    async def list(self) -> tuple[Announcement, ...]: ...

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from uuid import UUID

from app.application.announcements.execution.contracts import (
    PublicationExecutionRequest,
    PublicationExecutionResult,
)
from app.application.announcements.execution.durable_execution_service import (
    DurablePublicationExecutionService,
)
from app.domain.announcements.publication import Publication


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ApprovedPublicationExecutionService:
    """Application boundary from WS-23 approved state into WS-22."""

    durable_execution: DurablePublicationExecutionService

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.durable_execution is None:
            raise ValueError("durable_execution cannot be None.")

    async def execute(
        self,
        *,
        publication: Publication,
        actor: str,
        idempotency_key: str,
        correlation_id: str,
    ) -> PublicationExecutionResult:
        """Delegate an approved publication to the existing WS-22 service.

        WS-22 remains responsible for:
        - durable execution;
        - idempotency;
        - execution persistence;
        - execution audit;
        - retry semantics;
        - controlled provider invocation.
        """

        if publication is None:
            raise ValueError("publication cannot be None.")

        if not actor.strip():
            raise ValueError("actor cannot be empty.")

        if not idempotency_key.strip():
            raise ValueError("idempotency_key cannot be empty.")

        if not correlation_id.strip():
            raise ValueError("correlation_id cannot be empty.")

        try:
            publication_uuid = UUID(publication.publication_id)
        except (ValueError, AttributeError) as exc:
            raise ValueError(
                "Approved publication ID must be a UUID for WS-22 durable execution."
            ) from exc

        request = PublicationExecutionRequest(
            publication_id=publication_uuid,
            idempotency_key=idempotency_key.strip(),
            correlation_id=correlation_id.strip(),
            actor=actor.strip(),
        )

        return await self.durable_execution.execute(
            publication=_PublicationExecutionAdapter(publication),
            request=request,
        )


class _PublicationExecutionAdapter:
    """Adapt the WS-23 publication to the existing WS-22 execution contract."""

    def __init__(self, publication: Publication) -> None:
        self._publication = publication

    @property
    def id(self) -> UUID:
        return UUID(self._publication.publication_id)

    @property
    def title(self) -> str:
        return self._publication.title

    @property
    def content(self) -> str:
        return self._publication.content

    @property
    def status(self):
        return self._publication.status

    def begin_publish(self) -> None:
        self._publication.begin_publish()

    def mark_failure(self, reason: str) -> None:
        self._publication.mark_failure(reason)

    def publish_success(self, provider_message_id: str | None = None) -> None:
        del provider_message_id
        self._publication.publish_success()


__all__ = ["ApprovedPublicationExecutionService"]

"""WS-23.1.4 composition boundary.

Reuses the already-composed WS-22 durable execution service.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

from app.application.announcements.execution.approved_publication_execution import (
    ApprovedPublicationExecutionService,
)
from app.application.announcements.execution.durable_execution_service import (
    DurablePublicationExecutionService,
)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ApprovedPublicationExecutionComposition:
    service: ApprovedPublicationExecutionService
    durable_execution: DurablePublicationExecutionService


def create_approved_publication_execution_composition(
    *,
    durable_execution: DurablePublicationExecutionService,
) -> ApprovedPublicationExecutionComposition:
    """Compose WS-23.1.4 without creating any new infrastructure."""

    if durable_execution is None:
        raise ValueError("durable_execution cannot be None.")

    service = ApprovedPublicationExecutionService(
        durable_execution=durable_execution,
    )

    return ApprovedPublicationExecutionComposition(
        service=service,
        durable_execution=durable_execution,
    )


__all__ = [
    "ApprovedPublicationExecutionComposition",
    "create_approved_publication_execution_composition",
]

"""WS-22.3.1 provider-independent publication execution service."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Protocol
from uuid import UUID

from app.application.announcements.execution.contracts import (
    AnnouncementPublisher,
    PublicationExecutionRequest,
    PublicationExecutionResult,
    PublicationExecutionStatus,
)


class ExecutablePublication(Protocol):
    """Minimum aggregate surface required by the execution service."""

    id: UUID
    title: str
    content: str
    status: object

    def begin_publish(self) -> None: ...

    def publish_success(self, provider_message_id: str | None = None) -> None: ...

    def mark_failure(self, reason: str) -> None: ...


class PublicationExecutionAudit(Protocol):
    """Minimal audit boundary used by execution.

    The concrete publication-event repository remains an existing
    application concern; this protocol prevents execution from coupling to
    a particular persistence implementation.
    """

    async def record_success(
        self,
        *,
        publication_id: UUID,
        actor: str,
        correlation_id: str,
        provider_message_id: str | None,
    ) -> None: ...

    async def record_failure(
        self,
        *,
        publication_id: UUID,
        actor: str,
        correlation_id: str,
        error_code: str,
    ) -> None: ...


class PublicationExecutionService:
    """Execute approved publications through a provider-independent port.

    The service owns orchestration and idempotency. It does not know which
    channel/provider performs the external publication.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        publisher: AnnouncementPublisher,
        audit: PublicationExecutionAudit,
    ) -> None:
        if publisher is None:
            raise ValueError("publisher cannot be None.")
        if audit is None:
            raise ValueError("audit cannot be None.")
        self._publisher = publisher
        self._audit = audit
        self._completed: dict[str, PublicationExecutionResult] = {}

    async def execute(
        self,
        *,
        publication: ExecutablePublication,
        request: PublicationExecutionRequest,
    ) -> PublicationExecutionResult:
        if publication is None:
            raise ValueError("publication cannot be None.")

        existing = self._completed.get(request.idempotency_key)
        if existing is not None:
            return PublicationExecutionResult(
                publication_id=existing.publication_id,
                status=PublicationExecutionStatus.IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY,
                idempotency_key=existing.idempotency_key,
                correlation_id=request.correlation_id,
                provider_message_id=existing.provider_message_id,
                error_code=existing.error_code,
                error_message=existing.error_message,
            )

        self._assert_approved(publication)
        publication.begin_publish()

        try:
            provider_message_id = await self._publisher.publish(
                publication_id=publication.id,
                title=publication.title,
                content=publication.content,
                correlation_id=request.correlation_id,
                idempotency_key=request.idempotency_key,
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            error_code = self._error_code(exc)
            publication.mark_failure(error_code)
            await self._audit.record_failure(
                publication_id=publication.id,
                actor=request.actor,
                correlation_id=request.correlation_id,
                error_code=error_code,
            )
            result = PublicationExecutionResult(
                publication_id=publication.id,
                status=PublicationExecutionStatus.FAILED,
                idempotency_key=request.idempotency_key,
                correlation_id=request.correlation_id,
                error_code=error_code,
            )
            return result

        publication.publish_success(provider_message_id)
        await self._audit.record_success(
            publication_id=publication.id,
            actor=request.actor,
            correlation_id=request.correlation_id,
            provider_message_id=provider_message_id,
        )

        result = PublicationExecutionResult(
            publication_id=publication.id,
            status=PublicationExecutionStatus.SUCCEEDED,
            idempotency_key=request.idempotency_key,
            correlation_id=request.correlation_id,
            provider_message_id=provider_message_id,
        )
        self._completed[request.idempotency_key] = result
        return result

    @staticmethod
    def _assert_approved(publication: ExecutablePublication) -> None:
        status_value = getattr(publication.status, "value", publication.status)
        if status_value != "approved":
            raise ValueError(
                "Only approved publications may be executed."
            )

    @staticmethod
    def _error_code(exc: Exception) -> str:
        """Return a stable, non-sensitive operational error code."""
        explicit = getattr(exc, "error_code", None)
        if isinstance(explicit, str) and explicit.strip():
            return explicit.strip()[:100]
        return type(exc).__name__.upper()[:100]

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Mapping

from app.application.announcements.repositories import PublicationRepository
from app.application.announcements.template_registry import AnnouncementTemplateRegistry
from app.domain.announcements.publication import Publication
from app.domain.announcements.template_models import PublicationStatus


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PublicationPreview:
    publication_type: str
    template_id: str
    template_version: int
    content: str


class AnnouncementPublicationService:
    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        templates: AnnouncementTemplateRegistry,
        publications: PublicationRepository,
    ) -> None:
        if templates is None or publications is None:
            raise ValueError("templates and publications are required.")
        self._templates = templates
        self._publications = publications

    def preview(
        self,
        *,
        template_id: str,
        values: Mapping[str, str],
        version: int | None = None,
    ) -> PublicationPreview:
        template = self._templates.get_version(template_id, version)
        content = self._templates.preview(
            template_id=template_id,
            values=dict(values),
            version=template.version,
        )
        return PublicationPreview(
            publication_type=template.publication_type.value,
            template_id=template.template_id,
            template_version=template.version,
            content=content,
        )

    def create(
        self,
        *,
        publication_id: str,
        template_id: str,
        title: str,
        values: Mapping[str, str],
        version: int | None = None,
    ) -> Publication:
        template = self._templates.get_version(template_id, version)
        content = self._templates.preview(
            template_id=template_id,
            values=dict(values),
            version=template.version,
        )
        publication = Publication(
            publication_id=publication_id,
            template_id=template.template_id,
            template_version=template.version,
            publication_type=template.publication_type,
            title=title,
            content=content,
            status=PublicationStatus.DRAFT,
        )
        self._publications.save(publication)
        return publication

    def _get(self, publication_id: str) -> Publication:
        publication = self._publications.get(publication_id)
        if publication is None:
            raise LookupError(f"Unknown publication '{publication_id}'.")
        return publication

    def request_approval(self, publication_id: str) -> Publication:
        publication = self._get(publication_id)
        publication.request_approval()
        self._publications.save(publication)
        return publication

    def approve(self, publication_id: str) -> Publication:
        publication = self._get(publication_id)
        publication.approve()
        self._publications.save(publication)
        return publication

    def begin_publish(self, publication_id: str) -> Publication:
        publication = self._get(publication_id)
        publication.begin_publish()
        self._publications.save(publication)
        return publication

    def mark_publish_failure(self, publication_id: str, reason: str) -> Publication:
        publication = self._get(publication_id)
        publication.mark_failure(reason)
        self._publications.save(publication)
        return publication

    def mark_publish_success(self, publication_id: str) -> Publication:
        publication = self._get(publication_id)
        publication.publish_success()
        self._publications.save(publication)
        return publication

Security boundary:

FILE: C:\AI Folder\EasyChatBot-Hackathon\backend\app\application\operations_center\announcement_group_operations_api.py
"""
WS-21.18 Announcement Group Operations application API.

Read-only, fresh operational detail for the Announcement Group surface.

The API deliberately reuses the existing OperationalDashboardService
and the authoritative OperationalEventService supplied by the Operations
Center composition root.

No second incident/event store is created.

Security boundary:
    Raw operational event metadata is never exposed through this API.
    Only explicitly approved operational metadata keys are returned.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from app.application.health.operational_dashboard_service import (
    OperationalDashboardService,
)
from app.application.health.operational_event import (
    OperationalSurface,
)
from app.application.health.operational_event_service import (
    OperationalEventService,
)
from app.application.health.operational_incident import (
    OperationalIncident,
)


# Operational metadata explicitly approved for the Operations Center UI.
#
# Sensitive learner content, prompts, AI responses, credentials, tokens,
# and arbitrary provider payloads are deliberately excluded.
SAFE_EVENT_METADATA_KEYS = frozenset(
    {
        "safe_status",
    }
)


class AnnouncementGroupOperationsAPI:
    """Read-only application boundary for WS-21.18."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        dashboard_service: OperationalDashboardService,
        event_service: OperationalEventService | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        if dashboard_service is None:
            raise ValueError(
                "dashboard_service cannot be None."
            )

        self._dashboard_service = dashboard_service

        self._event_service = (
            event_service
            if event_service is not None
            else dashboard_service.event_service
        )

    async def get_details(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Build a fresh Announcement Group snapshot.

        Every request performs fresh dependency health evaluation and reads
        the current operational incident/event state.
        """

        snapshot = (
            await self._dashboard_service.create_dashboard_snapshot()
        )

        incidents = self._event_service.list_incidents(
            surface=OperationalSurface.ANNOUNCEMENT_GROUP,
        )

        events = tuple(
            event
            for incident in incidents
            for event in incident.events
        )

        return {
            "generated_at": snapshot.generated_at.isoformat(),
            "surface": "announcement_group",
            "status": (
                snapshot.announcement_group.status.value
            ),
            "health_score": snapshot.health_score,
            "dependencies": [
                dependency.as_dict()
                for dependency
                in snapshot.announcement_group.dependencies
            ],
            "metrics": (
                snapshot.announcement_group.metrics.as_dict()
            ),
            "incidents": {
                "summary": (
                    snapshot.announcement_group
                    .incidents
                    .as_dict()
                ),
                "items": [
                    _incident_to_dict(incident)
                    for incident in incidents
                ],
            },
            "events": [
                _event_to_dict(event)
                for event in events
            ],
        }


def _incident_to_dict(
    incident: OperationalIncident,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Return an existing incident in dashboard-safe form.

    Raw event metadata is deliberately not serialized.
    """

    return {
        "incident_id": incident.incident_id,
        "correlation_id": incident.correlation_id,
        "event_type": incident.event_type.value,
        "surface": incident.surface.value,
        "severity": incident.severity.value,
        "status": incident.status.value,
        "first_seen": incident.first_seen.isoformat(),
        "last_seen": incident.last_seen.isoformat(),
        "occurrence_count": incident.occurrence_count,
        "user_reference": incident.user_reference,
        "world_id": incident.world_id,
        "events": [
            _event_to_dict(event)
            for event in incident.events
        ],
    }


def _event_to_dict(event) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Serialize an operational event through an explicit security boundary.

    Do not call event.as_dict() here because that currently includes the
    complete raw metadata dictionary.
    """

    metadata = getattr(event, "metadata", {}) or {}

    safe_metadata = {
        key: metadata[key]
        for key in SAFE_EVENT_METADATA_KEYS
        if key in metadata
    }

    return {
        "event_type": event.event_type.value,
        "surface": event.surface.value,
        "correlation_id": event.correlation_id,
        "severity": event.severity.value,
        "occurred_at": event.occurred_at.isoformat(),
        "user_reference": event.user_reference,
        "world_id": event.world_id,
        "metadata": safe_metadata,
    }


__all__ = [
    "AnnouncementGroupOperationsAPI",
]

"""Announcement domain aggregate."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from uuid import UUID, uuid4

from .publication_status import PublicationStatus


@dataclass(slots=True)
class Announcement:
    """Official announcement and its controlled publication lifecycle."""

    title: str
    body: str
    created_by: str
    id: UUID = field(default_factory=uuid4)
    status: PublicationStatus = PublicationStatus.DRAFT
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    updated_at: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    approved_by: str | None = None
    approved_at: datetime | None = None

    def mark_ready_for_review(self) -> None:
        self._transition(PublicationStatus.READY_FOR_REVIEW)

    def approve(self, actor: str) -> None:
        if not actor.strip():
            raise ValueError("actor cannot be empty.")
        self._transition(PublicationStatus.APPROVED)
        self.approved_by = actor
        self.approved_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    def request_publication(self) -> None:
        self._transition(PublicationStatus.PUBLISH_REQUESTED)

    def mark_published(self) -> None:
        self._transition(PublicationStatus.PUBLISHED)

    def mark_failed(self) -> None:
        self._transition(PublicationStatus.FAILED)

    def archive(self) -> None:
        self._transition(PublicationStatus.ARCHIVED)

    def _transition(self, target: PublicationStatus) -> None:
        allowed = {
            PublicationStatus.DRAFT: {PublicationStatus.READY_FOR_REVIEW, PublicationStatus.ARCHIVED},
            PublicationStatus.READY_FOR_REVIEW: {PublicationStatus.DRAFT, PublicationStatus.APPROVED, PublicationStatus.ARCHIVED},
            PublicationStatus.APPROVED: {PublicationStatus.PUBLISH_REQUESTED, PublicationStatus.ARCHIVED},
            PublicationStatus.PUBLISH_REQUESTED: {PublicationStatus.PUBLISHED, PublicationStatus.FAILED},
            PublicationStatus.FAILED: {PublicationStatus.PUBLISH_REQUESTED, PublicationStatus.ARCHIVED},
            PublicationStatus.PUBLISHED: {PublicationStatus.ARCHIVED},
            PublicationStatus.ARCHIVED: set(),
        }
        if target not in allowed[self.status]:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid publication transition: {self.status} -> {target}.")
        self.status = target
        self.updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from .template_models import PublicationStatus, PublicationType


_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS = {
    PublicationStatus.DRAFT: {
        PublicationStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL,
        PublicationStatus.CANCELLED,
    },
    PublicationStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL: {
        PublicationStatus.APPROVED,
        PublicationStatus.CANCELLED,
    },
    PublicationStatus.APPROVED: {
        PublicationStatus.PUBLISHING,
        PublicationStatus.CANCELLED,
    },
    PublicationStatus.PUBLISHING: {
        PublicationStatus.PUBLISHED,
        PublicationStatus.FAILED,
    },
    PublicationStatus.FAILED: {
        PublicationStatus.PUBLISHING,
        PublicationStatus.CANCELLED,
    },
    PublicationStatus.PUBLISHED: set(),
    PublicationStatus.CANCELLED: set(),
}


@dataclass
class Publication:
    publication_id: str
    template_id: str
    template_version: int
    publication_type: PublicationType
    title: str
    content: str
    status: PublicationStatus = PublicationStatus.DRAFT
    created_at: datetime | None = None
    approved_at: datetime | None = None
    published_at: datetime | None = None
    failure_reason: str | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not self.publication_id.strip():
            raise ValueError("publication_id cannot be empty.")
        if not self.template_id.strip():
            raise ValueError("template_id cannot be empty.")
        if self.template_version < 1:
            raise ValueError("template_version must be >= 1.")
        if not self.title.strip():
            raise ValueError("title cannot be empty.")
        if not self.content.strip():
            raise ValueError("content cannot be empty.")
        if self.created_at is None:
            self.created_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    def transition(self, target: PublicationStatus) -> None:
        if target not in _ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS[self.status]:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Invalid publication transition: "
                f"{self.status.value} -> {target.value}"
            )
        self.status = target
        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        if target is PublicationStatus.APPROVED:
            self.approved_at = now
        elif target is PublicationStatus.PUBLISHED:
            self.published_at = now
            self.failure_reason = None

    def request_approval(self) -> None:
        self.transition(PublicationStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL)

    def approve(self) -> None:
        self.transition(PublicationStatus.APPROVED)

    def begin_publish(self) -> None:
        self.transition(PublicationStatus.PUBLISHING)

    def mark_failure(self, reason: str) -> None:
        if not reason.strip():
            raise ValueError("failure reason cannot be empty.")
        if self.status is not PublicationStatus.PUBLISHING:
            raise ValueError("A publication can only fail while publishing.")
        self.failure_reason = reason.strip()
        self.transition(PublicationStatus.FAILED)

    def publish_success(self) -> None:
        self.transition(PublicationStatus.PUBLISHED)

from uuid import UUID, uuid4


class PublicationEventType(StrEnum):
    CREATED = "publication_created"

    APPROVED = "publication_approved"
    PUBLISH_REQUESTED = "publication_publish_requested"
    PUBLISHED = "publication_published"
    FAILED = "publication_failed"
    RETRY_REQUESTED = "publication_retry_requested"
    ARCHIVED = "publication_archived"

class PublicationEvent:

    event_type: PublicationEventType
    actor: str
    correlation_id: str
    event_id: UUID = field(default_factory=uuid4)
    occurred_at: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    error_code: str | None = None
    provider_message_id: str | None = None

    READY_FOR_REVIEW  -> PENDING_APPROVAL

FILE: C:\AI Folder\EasyChatBot-Hackathon\backend\app\infrastructure\announcements\async_publication_repository_adapter.py
from __future__ import annotations

from app.application.announcements.repositories import PublicationRepository
from app.domain.announcements.publication import Publication
from app.infrastructure.announcements.sqlalchemy_publication_repository import (
    SqlAlchemyPublicationRepository,
)


class AsyncPublicationRepositoryAdapter(PublicationRepository):
    """Synchronous application contract adapter for the async PostgreSQL adapter.

    This adapter is intentionally not used from an async event loop. It exists
    for compatibility with the current synchronous AnnouncementPublicationService
    contract. Production composition should prefer an async application boundary
    when the application service is migrated.

    Calling these methods from an active async event loop would require blocking
    the loop, so this adapter fails closed rather than performing unsafe
    synchronous database I/O.
    """

    def __init__(self, repository: SqlAlchemyPublicationRepository) -> None:
        if repository is None:
            raise ValueError("repository cannot be None.")
        self._repository = repository

    def _reject_sync_boundary(self) -> None:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "AsyncPublicationRepositoryAdapter cannot be used through the "
            "synchronous PublicationRepository contract. Use the async "
            "approval composition."
        )

    def save(self, publication: Publication) -> None:
        self._reject_sync_boundary()

    def get(self, publication_id: str) -> Publication | None:
        self._reject_sync_boundary()
        return None

    def list_all(self) -> tuple[Publication, ...]:
        self._reject_sync_boundary()
        return ()

FILE: C:\AI Folder\EasyChatBot-Hackathon\backend\app\infrastructure\announcements\execution\telegram_publication_publisher_adapter.py
"""
WS-23.1.4 Telegram publication adapter.

Architecture:

WS-22 AnnouncementPublisher
        â†“
TelegramPublicationPublisherAdapter
        â†“
ControlledAnnouncementPublisher
        â†“
TelegramAnnouncementPublisher
        â†“
Existing Telegram client

This adapter:
- does not create a Telegram client;
- does not implement idempotency;
- does not create a repository;
- does not create a database;
- does not bypass the controlled publisher;
- translates the provider-independent WS-22 contract into the
  existing controlled Telegram publication boundary.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from os import getenv
from uuid import UUID

from app.application.announcement.announcement_publisher import (
    ControlledAnnouncementPublisher,
)
from app.application.announcements.execution.contracts import (
    AnnouncementPublisher,
)


class TelegramPublicationPublisherAdapter(AnnouncementPublisher):
    """Bridge the canonical WS-22 publisher contract to Telegram."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        publisher: ControlledAnnouncementPublisher,
        channel_id: str | None = None,
        announcement_type: str = "beta_update",
    ) -> None:
        if publisher is None:
            raise ValueError("publisher cannot be None.")

        resolved_channel_id = channel_id or getenv(
            "BETA1_ANNOUNCEMENT_CHANNEL_ID"
        )

        if not resolved_channel_id or not resolved_channel_id.strip():
            raise ValueError(
                "BETA1_ANNOUNCEMENT_CHANNEL_ID is not configured."
            )

        if not announcement_type.strip():
            raise ValueError(
                "announcement_type cannot be empty."
            )

        self._publisher = publisher
        self._channel_id = resolved_channel_id.strip()
        self._announcement_type = announcement_type.strip()

    async def publish(
        self,
        *,
        publication_id: UUID,
        title: str,
        content: str,
        correlation_id: str,
        idempotency_key: str,
    ) -> str | None:
        """
        Publish through the existing controlled Telegram boundary.

        WS-22 remains responsible for:
        - idempotency;
        - execution persistence;
        - execution audit;
        - retry semantics.

        This adapter only translates the publication request.
        """

        if not isinstance(publication_id, UUID):
            raise ValueError(
                "publication_id must be a UUID."
            )

        if not title.strip():
            raise ValueError(
                "title cannot be empty."
            )

        if not content.strip():
            raise ValueError(
                "content cannot be empty."
            )

        if not correlation_id.strip():
            raise ValueError(
                "correlation_id cannot be empty."
            )

        if not idempotency_key.strip():
            raise ValueError(
                "idempotency_key cannot be empty."
            )

        text = (
            f"*{title.strip()}*\n\n"
            f"{content.strip()}"
        )

        record = await self._publisher.publish(
            channel_id=self._channel_id,
            text=text,
            announcement_type=self._announcement_type,
        )

        return record.message_id


__all__ = [
    "TelegramPublicationPublisherAdapter",
]

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from sqlalchemy import DateTime, String, Text, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column

from app.domain.announcements.publication import Publication
from app.infrastructure.persistence.database import Base


class PublicationApprovalAuditEventModel(Base):
    """Durable audit evidence for human approval decisions."""

    __tablename__ = "announcement_publication_approval_audit_events"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    publication_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(255), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    event_type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=False)
    actor: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    occurred_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False
    )
    details: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)


class SqlAlchemyPublicationApprovalAudit:
    """Persist approval evidence using the canonical async session factory."""

    def __init__(self, session_factory) -> None:
        if session_factory is None:
            raise ValueError("session_factory cannot be None.")
        self._session_factory = session_factory

    async def record_approval(
        self,
        *,
        publication: Publication,
        actor: str,
        occurred_at: datetime,
    ) -> None:
        if not actor.strip():
            raise ValueError("actor cannot be empty.")

        event = PublicationApprovalAuditEventModel(
            publication_id=publication.publication_id,
            event_type="approved",
            actor=actor.strip(),
            occurred_at=occurred_at,
            details="Publication transitioned to APPROVED.",
        )

        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            session.add(event)
            await session.commit()

    async def list_for(
        self,
        publication_id: str,
    ) -> tuple[PublicationApprovalAuditEventModel, ...]:
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            result = await session.execute(
                select(PublicationApprovalAuditEventModel)
                .where(
                    PublicationApprovalAuditEventModel.publication_id
                    == publication_id
                )
                .order_by(PublicationApprovalAuditEventModel.id)
            )
            return tuple(result.scalars().all())


__all__ = [
    "PublicationApprovalAuditEventModel",
    "SqlAlchemyPublicationApprovalAudit",
]

class SqlAlchemyPublicationAuditRepository:
    """Persist publication execution audit using the existing session factory."""

    def __init__(self, session_factory) -> None:
        if session_factory is None:
            raise ValueError("session_factory cannot be None.")
        self._session_factory = session_factory

    async def record_success(
        self,
        *,
        publication_id: UUID,
        actor: str,
        correlation_id: str,
        provider_message_id: str | None,
    ) -> None:
        await self._record(
            publication_id=publication_id,
            event_type="published",
            actor=actor,
            correlation_id=correlation_id,
            provider_message_id=provider_message_id,
            error_code=None,
            details=None,
        )

    async def record_failure(
        self,
        *,
        publication_id: UUID,
        actor: str,
        correlation_id: str,
        error_code: str,
    ) -> None:
        await self._record(
            publication_id=publication_id,
            event_type="publish_failed",
            actor=actor,
            correlation_id=correlation_id,
            provider_message_id=None,
            error_code=error_code,
            details=None,
        )

    async def list_for(
        self, publication_id: UUID
    ) -> tuple[PublicationAuditEventModel, ...]:
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            result = await session.execute(
                select(PublicationAuditEventModel)
                .where(
                    PublicationAuditEventModel.publication_id
                    == str(publication_id)
                )
                .order_by(PublicationAuditEventModel.id)
            )
            return tuple(result.scalars().all())

    async def _record(
        self,
        *,
        publication_id: UUID,
        event_type: str,
        actor: str,
        correlation_id: str,
        provider_message_id: str | None,
        error_code: str | None,
        details: str | None,
    ) -> None:
        event = PublicationAuditEventModel(
            publication_id=str(publication_id),
            event_type=event_type,
            actor=actor,
            correlation_id=correlation_id,
            provider_message_id=provider_message_id,
            error_code=error_code,
            details=details,
            occurred_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        )
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            session.add(event)
            await session.commit()

"""SQLAlchemy durable execution repository for WS-22.

Uses the canonical EasyChatBot SQLAlchemy Base. This module deliberately does
not create a second DeclarativeBase/metadata registry.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from uuid import UUID

from sqlalchemy import DateTime, Integer, String, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession, async_sessionmaker
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column

from app.application.announcements.execution.durable_contracts import (
    DurableExecutionStatus,
    PublicationExecutionRecord,
    PublicationExecutionRepository,
)
from app.infrastructure.persistence.database import Base


class PublicationExecutionRecordModel(Base):
    """Durable operational state for a WS-22 publication execution."""

    __tablename__ = "announcement_publication_executions"

    publication_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), nullable=False)
    idempotency_key: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(255), primary_key=True
    )
    correlation_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(255),
        nullable=False,
    )
    attempt: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(
        Integer,
        nullable=False,
        default=1,
    )
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(32),
        nullable=False,
    )
    provider_message_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(
        String(255),
        nullable=True,
    )
    error_code: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(
        String(100),
        nullable=True,
    )
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True),
        nullable=False,
    )
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True),
        nullable=False,
    )


class SqlAlchemyPublicationExecutionRepository(
    PublicationExecutionRepository
):
    """Durable repository using the existing injected async session factory."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        session_factory: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession],
    ) -> None:
        if session_factory is None:
            raise ValueError("session_factory cannot be None.")

        self._session_factory = session_factory

    async def get_by_idempotency_key(
        self,
        idempotency_key: str,
    ) -> PublicationExecutionRecord | None:
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            result = await session.execute(
                select(PublicationExecutionRecordModel).where(
                    PublicationExecutionRecordModel.idempotency_key
                    == idempotency_key
                )
            )
            model = result.scalar_one_or_none()

            return self._to_domain(model) if model else None

    async def create_started(
        self,
        *,
        publication_id,
        idempotency_key,
        correlation_id,
    ) -> PublicationExecutionRecord:
        """Create the first durable execution attempt."""

        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

        model = PublicationExecutionRecordModel(
            publication_id=str(publication_id),
            idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
            correlation_id=correlation_id,
            attempt=1,
            status=DurableExecutionStatus.STARTED.value,
            created_at=now,
            updated_at=now,
        )

        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            session.add(model)
            await session.commit()
            await session.refresh(model)

            return self._to_domain(model)

    async def mark_succeeded(
        self,
        *,
        idempotency_key,
        provider_message_id,
    ) -> PublicationExecutionRecord:
        """Persist successful completion without changing the attempt count."""

        return await self._update(
            idempotency_key,
            status=DurableExecutionStatus.SUCCEEDED.value,
            provider_message_id=provider_message_id,
            error_code=None,
        )

    async def mark_failed(
        self,
        *,
        idempotency_key,
        error_code,
    ) -> PublicationExecutionRecord:
        """Persist failure while retaining the current attempt number."""

        return await self._update(
            idempotency_key,
            status=DurableExecutionStatus.FAILED.value,
            error_code=error_code,
        )

    async def start_retry(
        self,
        *,
        idempotency_key: str,
    ) -> PublicationExecutionRecord:
        """Increment the durable attempt counter for a retry.

        A retry is valid only for an existing FAILED execution. The same
        idempotency record is retained; no second database row is created.
        """

        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            result = await session.execute(
                select(PublicationExecutionRecordModel).where(
                    PublicationExecutionRecordModel.idempotency_key
                    == idempotency_key
                )
            )

            model = result.scalar_one()

            if model.status != DurableExecutionStatus.FAILED.value:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Only failed executions can be retried."
                )

            model.attempt += 1
            model.status = DurableExecutionStatus.STARTED.value
            model.error_code = None
            model.provider_message_id = None
            model.updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

            await session.commit()
            await session.refresh(model)

            return self._to_domain(model)

    async def _update(
        self,
        idempotency_key,
        **values,
    ) -> PublicationExecutionRecord:
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            result = await session.execute(
                select(PublicationExecutionRecordModel).where(
                    PublicationExecutionRecordModel.idempotency_key
                    == idempotency_key
                )
            )

            model = result.scalar_one()

            for key, value in values.items():
                setattr(model, key, value)

            model.updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

            await session.commit()
            await session.refresh(model)

            return self._to_domain(model)

    @staticmethod
    def _to_domain(
        model: PublicationExecutionRecordModel,
    ) -> PublicationExecutionRecord:
        return PublicationExecutionRecord(
            publication_id=UUID(model.publication_id),
            idempotency_key=model.idempotency_key,
            correlation_id=model.correlation_id,
            attempt=model.attempt,
            status=DurableExecutionStatus(model.status),
            provider_message_id=model.provider_message_id,
            error_code=model.error_code,
            created_at=model.created_at,
            updated_at=model.updated_at,
        )

"""PostgreSQL adapter for the existing PublicationRepository contract."""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from sqlalchemy import DateTime, Integer, String, Text, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession, async_sessionmaker
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column

from app.application.announcements.repositories import PublicationRepository
from app.domain.announcements.publication import Publication
from app.domain.announcements.template_models import (
    PublicationStatus,
    PublicationType,
)
from app.infrastructure.persistence.database import Base


class PublicationModel(Base):
    """Canonical durable announcement publication state."""

    __tablename__ = "announcement_publications"

    publication_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), primary_key=True)
    template_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    template_version: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False)
    publication_type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=False)
    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(120), nullable=False)
    content: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=False)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), nullable=False, index=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=False)
    approved_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True))
    published_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True))
    failure_reason: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text)


class SqlAlchemyPublicationRepository(PublicationRepository):
    """Async PostgreSQL adapter for the existing repository contract."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        session_factory: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession],
    ) -> None:
        if session_factory is None:
            raise ValueError("session_factory cannot be None.")
        self._session_factory = session_factory

    def _to_domain(self, model: PublicationModel) -> Publication:
        return Publication(
            publication_id=model.publication_id,
            template_id=model.template_id,
            template_version=model.template_version,
            publication_type=PublicationType(model.publication_type),
            title=model.title,
            content=model.content,
            status=PublicationStatus(model.status),
            created_at=model.created_at,
            approved_at=model.approved_at,
            published_at=model.published_at,
            failure_reason=model.failure_reason,
        )

    def _from_domain(self, publication: Publication) -> PublicationModel:
        return PublicationModel(
            publication_id=publication.publication_id,
            template_id=publication.template_id,
            template_version=publication.template_version,
            publication_type=publication.publication_type.value,
            title=publication.title,
            content=publication.content,
            status=publication.status.value,
            created_at=publication.created_at or datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            approved_at=publication.approved_at,
            published_at=publication.published_at,
            failure_reason=publication.failure_reason,
        )

    async def save_async(self, publication: Publication) -> None:
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            model = await session.get(
                PublicationModel,
                publication.publication_id,
            )
            if model is None:
                session.add(self._from_domain(publication))
            else:
                model.template_id = publication.template_id
                model.template_version = publication.template_version
                model.publication_type = publication.publication_type.value
                model.title = publication.title
                model.content = publication.content
                model.status = publication.status.value
                model.created_at = publication.created_at or model.created_at
                model.approved_at = publication.approved_at
                model.published_at = publication.published_at
                model.failure_reason = publication.failure_reason
            await session.commit()

    async def get_async(self, publication_id: str) -> Publication | None:
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            model = await session.get(PublicationModel, publication_id)
            return self._to_domain(model) if model else None

    async def list_all_async(self) -> tuple[Publication, ...]:
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            result = await session.execute(
                select(PublicationModel).order_by(PublicationModel.created_at)
            )
            return tuple(self._to_domain(model) for model in result.scalars().all())

    # The existing repository contract is synchronous. These methods make
    # accidental async DB use explicit rather than silently blocking.
    def save(self, publication: Publication) -> None:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "SqlAlchemyPublicationRepository requires its async boundary; "
            "use save_async()."
        )

    def get(self, publication_id: str) -> Publication | None:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "SqlAlchemyPublicationRepository requires its async boundary; "
            "use get_async()."
        )

    def list_all(self) -> tuple[Publication, ...]:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "SqlAlchemyPublicationRepository requires its async boundary; "
            "use list_all_async()."
        )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from alembic.config import Config
from alembic.migration import MigrationContext
from alembic.script import ScriptDirectory


def _config(project_root: Path, alembic_ini_path: Path | None = None) -> Config:
    root = project_root.resolve()
    ini_path = (alembic_ini_path or (root / "alembic.ini")).resolve()
    config = Config(str(ini_path))

    configured_location = config.get_main_option("script_location")
    if configured_location:
        # Resolve the configured location against the Alembic config directory.
        location = Path(configured_location)
        if not location.is_absolute():
            location = (ini_path.parent / location).resolve()
    else:
        location = (root / "backend" / "alembic").resolve()

    config.set_main_option("script_location", str(location))
    return config


def _repository_scripts(
    project_root: Path,
    alembic_ini_path: Path | None = None,
) -> ScriptDirectory:
    return ScriptDirectory.from_config(_config(project_root, alembic_ini_path))


def _database_revisions(connection: Any) -> list[str]:
    return sorted(MigrationContext.configure(connection).get_current_heads())


def _revision_graph(script: ScriptDirectory) -> dict[str, set[str]]:
    """Return revision -> direct parent revisions."""
    graph: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
    for revision in script.walk_revisions():
        parents = revision.down_revision
        if parents is None:
            graph[revision.revision] = set()
        elif isinstance(parents, tuple):
            graph[revision.revision] = set(parents)
        else:
            graph[revision.revision] = {parents}
    return graph


def _ancestors(revision: str, graph: dict[str, set[str]]) -> set[str]:
    found: set[str] = set()
    stack = [revision]
    while stack:
        current = stack.pop()
        for parent in graph.get(current, set()):
            if parent not in found:
                found.add(parent)
                stack.append(parent)
    return found


def _pending_revisions(
    repo_heads: list[str],
    current_heads: list[str],
    graph: dict[str, set[str]],
) -> list[str]:
    if not repo_heads:
        return []

    required: set[str] = set()
    for head in repo_heads:
        required.add(head)
        required.update(_ancestors(head, graph))

    applied: set[str] = set()
    for head in current_heads:
        applied.add(head)
        applied.update(_ancestors(head, graph))

    return sorted(required - applied)


def _migration_lineage(
    script: ScriptDirectory,
    *,
    current_heads: list[str],
    pending: list[str],
    unknown: list[str],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    graph = _revision_graph(script)
    applied: set[str] = set()
    for head in current_heads:
        applied.add(head)
        applied.update(_ancestors(head, graph))
    pending_set = set(pending)
    current_set = set(current_heads)

    history = []
    for revision in sorted(graph):
        history.append(
            {
                "revision": revision,
                "down_revision": sorted(graph[revision]),
                "status": (
                    "CURRENT"
                    if revision in current_set
                    else "APPLIED"
                    if revision in applied
                    else "PENDING"
                    if revision in pending_set
                    else "NOT_REACHED"
                ),
            }
        )
    for revision in unknown:
        history.append(
            {
                "revision": revision,
                "down_revision": [],
                "status": "UNKNOWN_DATABASE_REVISION",
            }
        )
    return history


def _migration_risk(
    script: ScriptDirectory,
    revision_ids: list[str],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Provide a conservative source scan; this is advisory, not execution safety."""
    findings: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    dangerous = (
        "drop_column",
        "drop_table",
        "drop_constraint",
        "op.drop",
        "alter_column",
    )
    medium = (
        "create_index",
        "op.create_index",
        "rename",
        "add_column",
        "create_table",
    )
    for revision_id in revision_ids:
        try:
            revision = script.get_revision(revision_id)
            path = Path(revision.path) if revision.path else None
            source = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if path and path.exists() else ""
            lowered = source.lower()
            risk = "LOW"
            reasons: list[str] = []
            if any(token in lowered for token in dangerous):
                risk = "HIGH"
                reasons.append("Potentially destructive or lock-sensitive DDL detected.")
            elif any(token in lowered for token in medium):
                risk = "MEDIUM"
                reasons.append("Schema/index change detected; review before promotion.")
            findings.append(
                {
                    "revision": revision_id,
                    "risk": risk,
                    "reasons": reasons,
                    "analysis_mode": "HEURISTIC_SOURCE_SCAN",
                }
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            findings.append(
                {
                    "revision": revision_id,
                    "risk": "UNKNOWN",
                    "reasons": [
                        f"Unable to inspect migration source: {type(exc).__name__}"
                    ],
                    "analysis_mode": "HEURISTIC_SOURCE_SCAN",
                }
            )
    return findings


def inspect_migrations(
    engine: Any,
    *,
    project_root: Path,
    alembic_ini_path: Path | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    checked_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    try:
        script = _repository_scripts(project_root, alembic_ini_path)
        with engine.connect() as connection:
            db_revisions = _database_revisions(connection)

        repo_heads = sorted(script.get_heads())
        graph = _revision_graph(script)
        known_revisions = set(graph)
        missing = sorted(
            revision for revision in db_revisions if revision not in known_revisions
        )

        # A database state with two heads where one is an ancestor of the other
        # is suspicious and should never be treated as clean.
        current_ancestor_conflict = any(
            a != b and a in _ancestors(b, graph)
            for a in db_revisions
            for b in db_revisions
        )

        if missing or current_ancestor_conflict:
            graph_state = "INCONSISTENT"
            pending: list[str] | None = None
        else:
            pending_list = _pending_revisions(repo_heads, db_revisions, graph)
            graph_state = "IN_SYNC" if not pending_list else "PENDING"
            pending = pending_list

        candidate_revisions = pending or []
        return {
            "graph": graph_state,
            "database_revisions": db_revisions,
            "repository_heads": repo_heads,
            "missing_revisions": missing,
            "pending_migrations": pending,
            "drift": graph_state == "INCONSISTENT",
            "migration_safety": _migration_risk(script, candidate_revisions),
            "migration_history": _migration_lineage(
                script,
                current_heads=db_revisions,
                pending=candidate_revisions,
                unknown=missing,
            ),
            "checked_at": checked_at.isoformat(),
            "error": None,
        }
    except Exception as exc:
        return {
            "graph": "ERROR",
            "database_revisions": [],
            "repository_heads": [],
            "missing_revisions": [],
            "pending_migrations": None,
            "drift": True,
            "migration_safety": [],
            "migration_history": [],
            "checked_at": checked_at.isoformat(),
            "error": f"{type(exc).__name__}: migration diagnostics could not be completed.",
        }
