from __future__ import annotations

import os
from typing import Any

from telegram import Bot


class TelegramAnnouncementClient:
    """
    Outbound-only Telegram client for controlled announcements.

    This client is completely separate from TelegramBotRuntime.

    Responsibilities:
    - resolve TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN;
    - create an outbound Telegram Bot client lazily;
    - send controlled announcement messages;
    - release client resources.

    This client does NOT:
    - poll Telegram updates;
    - register handlers;
    - start polling;
    - execute classroom conversations;
    - perform administrator authorization;
    - bypass ControlledAnnouncementPublisher.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        token: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._token = (
            token
            or os.getenv("TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN")
        )

        if not self._token:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN is missing."
            )

        self._bot: Bot | None = None

    def _get_bot(self) -> Bot:
        """
        Return the outbound-only Telegram Bot client.

        The Bot is created lazily and never starts polling.
        """

        if self._bot is None:
            self._bot = Bot(
                token=self._token,
            )

        return self._bot

    async def send_message(
        self,
        *,
        chat_id: str,
        text: str,
        parse_mode: str | None = None,
    ) -> Any:
        """
        Send one outbound Telegram message.

        No Telegram polling is performed.
        """

        bot = self._get_bot()

        return await bot.send_message(
            chat_id=chat_id,
            text=text,
            parse_mode=parse_mode,
        )

    async def close(self) -> None:
        """
        Release the outbound Telegram client.
        """

        if self._bot is None:
            return

        await self._bot.shutdown()

        self._bot = None


__all__ = [
    "TelegramAnnouncementClient",
]

FILE: C:\AI Folder\EasyChatBot-Hackathon\backend\app\infrastructure\telegram\telegram_announcement_publisher.py
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


class TelegramAnnouncementPublisher:
    """Thin infrastructure adapter for the Telegram announcement channel."""

    def __init__(self, *, telegram_client: Any) -> None:
        if telegram_client is None:
            raise ValueError("telegram_client cannot be None.")

        self._telegram_client = telegram_client

    async def publish(
        self,
        *,
        channel_id: str,
        text: str,
    ) -> str:
        if not channel_id.strip():
            raise ValueError("channel_id is required.")

        if not text.strip():
            raise ValueError("text is required.")

        result = await self._telegram_client.send_message(
            chat_id=channel_id,
            text=text,
            parse_mode="Markdown",
        )

        message_id = getattr(result, "message_id", None)
        if message_id is None:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Telegram publisher did not receive a message identifier."
            )

        return str(message_id)

    email_verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    approved BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    active_world_id VARCHAR(128),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_beta_users_active_world_id
    ON beta_users(active_world_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS beta_connection_tokens (
    id VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY,
    token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    user_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL REFERENCES beta_users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    used_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_beta_connection_tokens_user_id
    ON beta_connection_tokens(user_id);

    id VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL REFERENCES beta_users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    telegram_user_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    chat_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    connected_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT uq_telegram_binding_beta_user UNIQUE(user_id)
);

    ON telegram_bindings(user_id);

"""
Model Capability Definition.

Describes what an AI model can support.

Used by the Runtime to select appropriate models.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ModelCapabilities:
    """
    Capabilities supported by a model.
    """

    text_generation: bool = True
    reasoning: bool = False
    tool_usage: bool = False
    vision: bool = False
    audio: bool = False

"""
Model Descriptor.

Combines model identity and capabilities.

The Runtime uses this information
without depending on a specific provider.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass

from runtime.models.model_id import ModelId
from runtime.models.model_capabilities import ModelCapabilities


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ModelDescriptor:
    """
    Describes an available AI model.

    Attributes:

        model_id:
            Unique model identity.

        capabilities:
            Supported capabilities.

        description:
            Human-readable explanation.
    """

    model_id: ModelId

    capabilities: ModelCapabilities

    description: str = ""

"""
Model Identifier.

Defines a stable identifier for AI models.

The identifier is independent from provider execution logic.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ModelId:
    """
    Unique identifier for an AI model.

    Examples:

    gemini-2.5-flash
    gpt-5-mini
    llama3

    """

    provider: str
    name: str

    def full_name(self) -> str:
        """
        Returns the complete model identifier.
        """

        return f"{self.provider}:{self.name}"

import pytest

from app.application.announcement.announcement_policy import (
    AnnouncementPolicy,
    AnnouncementPolicyError,
)
from app.application.announcement.models import Announcement, AnnouncementType


def test_valid_announcement_passes():
    AnnouncementPolicy().validate(
        Announcement(
            announcement_type=AnnouncementType.IMPORTANT,
            title="Important update",
            body="The Beta service remains available.",
        )
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("title", "body"),
    [
        ("", "Valid body"),
        ("Valid title", ""),
    ],
)
def test_required_content_is_enforced(title, body):
    with pytest.raises(AnnouncementPolicyError):
        AnnouncementPolicy().validate(
            Announcement(
                announcement_type=AnnouncementType.IMPORTANT,
                title=title,
                body=body,
            )
        )


def test_title_length_is_limited():
    with pytest.raises(AnnouncementPolicyError):
        AnnouncementPolicy().validate(
            Announcement(
                announcement_type=AnnouncementType.IMPORTANT,
                title="x" * 121,
                body="Body",
            )
        )


def test_body_length_is_limited():
    with pytest.raises(AnnouncementPolicyError):
        AnnouncementPolicy().validate(
            Announcement(
                announcement_type=AnnouncementType.IMPORTANT,
                title="Title",
                body="x" * 1801,
            )
        )



FILE: C:\AI Folder\EasyChatBot-Hackathon\backend\tests\announcement\test_announcement_publisher.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

import pytest

from app.application.announcement.announcement_publisher import (
    ControlledAnnouncementPublisher,
    PublicationDisabledError,
)
from app.infrastructure.telegram.telegram_announcement_publisher import (
    TelegramAnnouncementPublisher,
)


@dataclass
class FakeTelegramMessage:
    message_id: int


class FakeTelegramClient:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.calls: list[dict] = []

    async def send_message(
        self,
        *,
        chat_id: str,
        text: str,
        parse_mode: str,
    ) -> FakeTelegramMessage:
        self.calls.append(
            {
                "chat_id": chat_id,
                "text": text,
                "parse_mode": parse_mode,
            }
        )
        return FakeTelegramMessage(message_id=42)


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_telegram_publisher_is_thin_adapter():
    client = FakeTelegramClient()

    publisher = TelegramAnnouncementPublisher(
        telegram_client=client,
    )

    message_id = await publisher.publish(
        channel_id="-100123",
        text="Hello",
    )

    assert message_id == "42"
    assert client.calls == [
        {
            "chat_id": "-100123",
            "text": "Hello",
            "parse_mode": "Markdown",
        }
    ]


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_controlled_publisher_blocks_when_disabled():
    client = FakeTelegramClient()

    publisher = ControlledAnnouncementPublisher(
        publisher=TelegramAnnouncementPublisher(
            telegram_client=client,
        ),
        publishing_enabled=False,
    )

    with pytest.raises(PublicationDisabledError):
        await publisher.publish(
            channel_id="-100123",
            text="Hello",
            announcement_type="important",
        )

    assert client.calls == []


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_controlled_publisher_records_success():
    client = FakeTelegramClient()

    publisher = ControlledAnnouncementPublisher(
        publisher=TelegramAnnouncementPublisher(
            telegram_client=client,
        ),
        publishing_enabled=True,
    )

    record = await publisher.publish(
        channel_id="-100123",
        text="Hello",
        announcement_type="important",
    )

    assert record.channel_id == "-100123"
    assert record.message_id == "42"
    assert record.announcement_type == "important"
    assert record.published_at.tzinfo is not None

import pytest

from app.application.announcement_operations.publication_execution_service import (
    PublicationExecutionService,
)
from app.domain.announcement_publication.execution import (
    PublishAnnouncementCommand,
    PublicationExecutionStatus,
)
from app.application.announcement_operations.publication_execution_ports import (
    PublicationForExecution,
)


class FakeRepository:
    def __init__(self, publication=None):
        self.publication = publication
        self.results = []

    async def get_for_execution(self, publication_id):
        return self.publication

    async def record_execution(self, result):
        self.results.append(result)


class FakePublisher:
    def __init__(self, reference="provider-123", error=None):
        self.reference = reference
        self.error = error
        self.calls = 0

    async def publish(self, *, publication, idempotency_key):
        self.calls += 1
        if self.error:
            raise RuntimeError(self.error)
        return self.reference


class FakeIdempotencyStore:
    def __init__(self):
        self.results = {}

    async def get_result(self, idempotency_key):
        return self.results.get(idempotency_key)

    async def store_result(self, result):
        self.results[result.idempotency_key] = result


class FakeAuditSink:
    def __init__(self):
        self.events = []

    async def record(self, event):
        self.events.append(event)


def make_service(publication=None, publisher=None):
    repository = FakeRepository(publication)
    publisher = publisher or FakePublisher()
    idempotency = FakeIdempotencyStore()
    audit = FakeAuditSink()

    service = PublicationExecutionService(
        repository=repository,
        publisher=publisher,
        idempotency_store=idempotency,
        audit_sink=audit,
    )
    return service, repository, publisher, idempotency, audit


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_ws22_3_1_executes_approved_publication():
    service, repository, publisher, _idempotency, audit = make_service(
        PublicationForExecution(
            publication_id="pub-001",
            status="approved",
            destination="announcement-group",
            rendered_content="Approved announcement",
        )
    )

    result = await service.execute(
        PublishAnnouncementCommand(
            publication_id="pub-001",
            idempotency_key="idem-001",
            requested_by="operator-001",
        )
    )

    assert result.status is PublicationExecutionStatus.SUCCEEDED
    assert result.provider_reference == "provider-123"
    assert publisher.calls == 1
    assert len(repository.results) == 1
    assert len(audit.events) == 1


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_ws22_3_1_rejects_non_executable_publication():
    service, repository, publisher, _idempotency, audit = make_service(
        PublicationForExecution(
            publication_id="pub-002",
            status="draft",
            destination="announcement-group",
            rendered_content="Draft",
        )
    )

    result = await service.execute(
        PublishAnnouncementCommand(
            publication_id="pub-002",
            idempotency_key="idem-002",
            requested_by="operator-001",
        )
    )

    assert result.status is PublicationExecutionStatus.FAILED
    assert publisher.calls == 0
    assert len(repository.results) == 1
    assert len(audit.events) == 1


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_ws22_3_1_is_idempotent():
    service, _repository, publisher, idempotency, _audit = make_service(
        PublicationForExecution(
            publication_id="pub-003",
            status="approved",
            destination="announcement-group",
            rendered_content="Approved",
        )
    )

    command = PublishAnnouncementCommand(
        publication_id="pub-003",
        idempotency_key="idem-003",
        requested_by="operator-001",
    )

    first = await service.execute(command)
    second = await service.execute(command)

    assert first.status is PublicationExecutionStatus.SUCCEEDED
    assert second.status is PublicationExecutionStatus.SUCCEEDED
    assert first.provider_reference == second.provider_reference
    assert publisher.calls == 1
    assert len(idempotency.results) == 1


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_ws22_3_1_records_provider_failure():
    service, _repository, publisher, _idempotency, audit = make_service(
        PublicationForExecution(
            publication_id="pub-004",
            status="approved",
            destination="announcement-group",
            rendered_content="Approved",
        ),
        publisher=FakePublisher(error="channel unavailable"),
    )

    result = await service.execute(
        PublishAnnouncementCommand(
            publication_id="pub-004",
            idempotency_key="idem-004",
            requested_by="operator-001",
        )
    )

    assert result.status is PublicationExecutionStatus.FAILED
    assert result.error_message == "channel unavailable"
    assert len(audit.events) == 1
    assert audit.events[0].safe_metadata == {
        "execution_status": "failed"
    }


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_ws22_3_1_does_not_put_content_or_secrets_in_audit_event():
    service, _repository, _publisher, _idempotency, audit = make_service(
        PublicationForExecution(
            publication_id="pub-005",
            status="approved",
            destination="announcement-group",
            rendered_content="PRIVATE CONTENT api_key=SECRET",
        )
    )

    await service.execute(
        PublishAnnouncementCommand(
            publication_id="pub-005",
            idempotency_key="idem-005",
            requested_by="operator-001",
        )
    )

    audit_payload = str(audit.events[0]).lower()

    assert "private content" not in audit_payload
    assert "secret" not in audit_payload
    assert "api_key" not in audit_payload

from __future__ import annotations

from uuid import UUID

import pytest

from app.application.announcements.announcement_operations_service import AnnouncementOperationsService
from app.application.announcements.in_memory_repositories import InMemoryAnnouncementRepository, InMemoryPublicationEventRepository
from app.domain.announcements.publication_event import PublicationEventType
from app.domain.announcements.publication_status import PublicationStatus


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_lifecycle_and_audit_events() -> None:
    service = AnnouncementOperationsService(
        repository=InMemoryAnnouncementRepository(),
        event_repository=InMemoryPublicationEventRepository(),
    )
    item = await service.create(title="Beta 2", body="Release", actor="admin", correlation_id="ann-1")
    assert item.status is PublicationStatus.DRAFT

    await service.mark_ready_for_review(item.id, actor="admin")
    await service.approve(item.id, actor="admin")
    await service.request_publication(item.id, actor="admin")
    await service.mark_published(item.id, actor="admin", provider_message_id="tg-1")

    assert (await service.get(item.id)).status is PublicationStatus.PUBLISHED
    events = await service.audit_log(item.id)
    assert [event.event_type for event in events] == [
        PublicationEventType.CREATED,
        PublicationEventType.READY_FOR_REVIEW,
        PublicationEventType.APPROVED,
        PublicationEventType.PUBLISH_REQUESTED,
        PublicationEventType.PUBLISHED,
    ]
    assert events[-1].provider_message_id == "tg-1"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_failed_publication_is_recorded() -> None:
    service = AnnouncementOperationsService(
        repository=InMemoryAnnouncementRepository(),
        event_repository=InMemoryPublicationEventRepository(),
    )
    item = await service.create(title="Notice", body="Maintenance", actor="admin")
    await service.mark_ready_for_review(item.id, actor="admin")
    await service.approve(item.id, actor="admin")
    await service.request_publication(item.id, actor="admin")
    await service.mark_failed(item.id, actor="admin", error_code="TELEGRAM_TIMEOUT")

    assert (await service.get(item.id)).status is PublicationStatus.FAILED
    events = await service.audit_log(item.id)
    assert events[-1].event_type is PublicationEventType.FAILED
    assert events[-1].error_code == "TELEGRAM_TIMEOUT"


def test_invalid_transition_is_rejected() -> None:
    from app.domain.announcements.announcement import Announcement
    item = Announcement(title="A", body="B", created_by="admin")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        item.mark_published()


FILE: C:\AI Folder\EasyChatBot-Hackathon\backend\tests\announcements\test_ws22_0x_publication_lifecycle_alignment.py
from __future__ import annotations

from app.domain.announcements.publication import Publication
from app.domain.announcements.publication_status import (
    PublicationStatus,
)
from app.domain.announcements.template_models import (
    PublicationStatus as TemplatePublicationStatus,
    PublicationType,
)


def _publication_type() -> PublicationType:
    """Use an existing publication type without inventing one.

    WS-22.0.x validates lifecycle alignment, not publication-type
    vocabulary.
    """

    members = tuple(PublicationType)

    if not members:
        raise AssertionError(
            "PublicationType must define at least one publication type."
        )

    return members[0]


def _publication() -> Publication:
    return Publication(
        publication_id="ws22-0x-001",
        template_id="beta-release",
        template_version=1,
        publication_type=_publication_type(),
        title="Beta release",
        content="EasyChatBot Beta release announcement.",
    )


def test_ws22_0x_uses_one_canonical_publication_status_enum():
    """The application exposes one PublicationStatus enum."""

    assert PublicationStatus is TemplatePublicationStatus


def test_ws22_0x_canonical_lifecycle():
    """Validate the canonical WS-22 publication lifecycle."""

    publication = _publication()

    assert publication.status is PublicationStatus.DRAFT

    publication.request_approval()

    assert publication.status is PublicationStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL

    publication.approve()

    assert publication.status is PublicationStatus.APPROVED

    publication.begin_publish()

    assert publication.status is PublicationStatus.PUBLISHING

    publication.publish_success()

    assert publication.status is PublicationStatus.PUBLISHED


def test_ws22_0x_failed_publication_can_retry():
    """A failed publication can return to PUBLISHING."""

    publication = _publication()

    publication.request_approval()
    publication.approve()
    publication.begin_publish()

    publication.mark_failure(
        "publisher unavailable",
    )

    assert publication.status is PublicationStatus.FAILED

    assert publication.failure_reason == (
        "publisher unavailable"
    )

    publication.begin_publish()

    assert publication.status is PublicationStatus.PUBLISHING


def test_ws22_0x_preserves_legacy_lifecycle_aliases():
    """Existing Announcement Operations vocabulary remains compatible."""

    assert (
        PublicationStatus.READY_FOR_REVIEW
        is PublicationStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL
    )

    assert (
        PublicationStatus.PUBLISH_REQUESTED
        is PublicationStatus.PUBLISHING
    )

    assert (
        PublicationStatus.ARCHIVED
        is PublicationStatus.CANCELLED
    )

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from app.application.announcements.audit import (
    AnnouncementAuditEventType,
    InMemoryAnnouncementAuditSink,
)
from app.application.announcements.publication_service import AnnouncementPublicationService
from app.application.announcements.template_registry import AnnouncementTemplateRegistry
from app.domain.announcements.publication import Publication
from app.domain.announcements.template_models import (
    AnnouncementTemplate,
    AnnouncementTemplateVersion,
    PublicationStatus,
    PublicationType,
)
from app.infrastructure.announcements.in_memory_repositories import (
    InMemoryAnnouncementTemplateRepository,
    InMemoryPublicationRepository,
)


def make_template(version: int = 1) -> AnnouncementTemplate:
    tv = AnnouncementTemplateVersion(
        template_id="beta-update",
        version=version,
        publication_type=PublicationType.BETA_UPDATE,
        structure=(
            "ðŸŒ± EasyWorld â€” Growing with You",
            "",
            "BETA UPDATE",
            "",
            "{{title}}",
            "",
            "{{body}}",
            "",
            "{{timing}}",
        ),
        required_fields=frozenset({"title", "body"}),
        optional_fields=frozenset({"timing"}),
    )
    return AnnouncementTemplate(
        template_id="beta-update",
        name="Beta Update",
        publication_type=PublicationType.BETA_UPDATE,
        active_version=version,
        versions=(tv,),
    )


def make_service():
    template_repo = InMemoryAnnouncementTemplateRepository()
    registry = AnnouncementTemplateRegistry(template_repo)
    registry.register(make_template())
    publication_repo = InMemoryPublicationRepository()
    service = AnnouncementPublicationService(
        templates=registry,
        publications=publication_repo,
    )
    return service, registry, publication_repo


def test_required_template_fields_are_enforced():
    _, registry, _ = make_service()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Missing required"):
        registry.preview(template_id="beta-update", values={"title": "X"})


def test_publication_captures_version_and_content_snapshot():
    service, _, repo = make_service()
    publication = service.create(
        publication_id="pub-001",
        template_id="beta-update",
        title="Beta 2",
        values={"title": "Beta 2", "body": "A new beta is available.", "timing": "Today"},
    )
    assert publication.template_id == "beta-update"
    assert publication.template_version == 1
    assert "A new beta is available." in publication.content
    assert repo.get("pub-001").content == publication.content


def test_publication_lifecycle_is_controlled():
    service, _, repo = make_service()
    service.create(
        publication_id="pub-002",
        template_id="beta-update",
        title="Maintenance",
        values={"title": "Maintenance", "body": "Scheduled maintenance."},
    )
    service.request_approval("pub-002")
    service.approve("pub-002")
    service.begin_publish("pub-002")
    service.mark_publish_success("pub-002")
    stored = repo.get("pub-002")
    assert stored.status is PublicationStatus.PUBLISHED
    assert stored.published_at is not None


def test_failed_publication_records_reason():
    service, _, repo = make_service()
    service.create(
        publication_id="pub-003",
        template_id="beta-update",
        title="Announcement",
        values={"title": "Announcement", "body": "Content"},
    )
    service.request_approval("pub-003")
    service.approve("pub-003")
    service.begin_publish("pub-003")
    service.mark_publish_failure("pub-003", "Telegram timeout")
    stored = repo.get("pub-003")
    assert stored.status is PublicationStatus.FAILED
    assert stored.failure_reason == "Telegram timeout"


def test_invalid_transition_is_rejected():
    publication = Publication(
        publication_id="pub-004",
        template_id="beta-update",
        template_version=1,
        publication_type=PublicationType.BETA_UPDATE,
        title="Test",
        content="Content",
    )
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Invalid publication transition"):
        publication.publish_success()


def test_audit_sink_records_events():
    sink = InMemoryAnnouncementAuditSink()
    sink.record("pub-005", AnnouncementAuditEventType.CREATED)
    sink.record("pub-005", AnnouncementAuditEventType.APPROVED)
    sink.record("pub-005", AnnouncementAuditEventType.PUBLISH_FAILED, "Telegram timeout")
    events = sink.list_for("pub-005")
    assert [e.event_type for e in events] == [
        AnnouncementAuditEventType.CREATED,
        AnnouncementAuditEventType.APPROVED,
        AnnouncementAuditEventType.PUBLISH_FAILED,
    ]
    assert events[-1].details == "Telegram timeout"


FILE: C:\AI Folder\EasyChatBot-Hackathon\backend\tests\announcements\test_ws22_3_1_publication_execution_contract.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from uuid import uuid4

import pytest

from app.application.announcements.execution.contracts import (
    PublicationExecutionRequest,
    PublicationExecutionStatus,
)
from app.application.announcements.execution.publication_execution_service import (
    PublicationExecutionService,
)
from app.domain.announcements.publication_status import PublicationStatus


@dataclass
class FakePublication:
    id: object
    title: str = "Beta 2"
    content: str = "Release announcement"
    status: PublicationStatus = PublicationStatus.APPROVED

    def begin_publish(self) -> None:
        self.status = PublicationStatus.PUBLISHING

    def publish_success(self, provider_message_id: str | None = None) -> None:
        self.status = PublicationStatus.PUBLISHED

    def mark_failure(self, reason: str) -> None:
        self.status = PublicationStatus.FAILED


class FakePublisher:
    def __init__(self, message_id: str = "provider-1") -> None:
        self.calls = 0
        self.message_id = message_id

    async def publish(self, **kwargs) -> str:
        self.calls += 1
        return self.message_id


class FailingPublisher:
    async def publish(self, **kwargs) -> str:
        raise RuntimeError("private provider response must not be audited")


class FakeAudit:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.successes = []
        self.failures = []

    async def record_success(self, **kwargs) -> None:
        self.successes.append(kwargs)

    async def record_failure(self, **kwargs) -> None:
        self.failures.append(kwargs)


def request(publication_id):
    return PublicationExecutionRequest(
        publication_id=publication_id,
        idempotency_key="exec-001",
        actor="admin",
        correlation_id="corr-001",
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_approved_publication_executes_and_audits_success():
    publication = FakePublication(uuid4())
    publisher = FakePublisher()
    audit = FakeAudit()
    service = PublicationExecutionService(publisher=publisher, audit=audit)

    result = await service.execute(
        publication=publication,
        request=request(publication.id),
    )

    assert result.status is PublicationExecutionStatus.SUCCEEDED
    assert result.provider_message_id == "provider-1"
    assert publication.status is PublicationStatus.PUBLISHED
    assert publisher.calls == 1
    assert len(audit.successes) == 1
    assert audit.successes[0]["provider_message_id"] == "provider-1"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_same_idempotency_key_does_not_publish_twice():
    publication = FakePublication(uuid4())
    publisher = FakePublisher()
    audit = FakeAudit()
    service = PublicationExecutionService(publisher=publisher, audit=audit)
    first = request(publication.id)

    result_one = await service.execute(publication=publication, request=first)
    result_two = await service.execute(
        publication=publication,
        request=first,
    )

    assert result_one.status is PublicationExecutionStatus.SUCCEEDED
    assert result_two.status is PublicationExecutionStatus.IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY
    assert publisher.calls == 1
    assert len(audit.successes) == 1


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_non_approved_publication_is_rejected_before_publish():
    publication = FakePublication(uuid4(), status=PublicationStatus.DRAFT)
    publisher = FakePublisher()
    audit = FakeAudit()
    service = PublicationExecutionService(publisher=publisher, audit=audit)

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="approved"):
        await service.execute(
            publication=publication,
            request=request(publication.id),
        )

    assert publisher.calls == 0
    assert publication.status is PublicationStatus.DRAFT
    assert audit.successes == []
    assert audit.failures == []


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_publisher_failure_updates_lifecycle_and_audits_stable_error_code():
    publication = FakePublication(uuid4())
    audit = FakeAudit()
    service = PublicationExecutionService(
        publisher=FailingPublisher(),
        audit=audit,
    )

    result = await service.execute(
        publication=publication,
        request=request(publication.id),
    )

    assert result.status is PublicationExecutionStatus.FAILED
    assert result.error_code == "RUNTIMEERROR"
    assert publication.status is PublicationStatus.FAILED
    assert len(audit.failures) == 1
    assert audit.failures[0]["error_code"] == "RUNTIMEERROR"
    assert "private provider response" not in str(audit.failures).lower()


FILE: C:\AI Folder\EasyChatBot-Hackathon\backend\tests\announcements\test_ws23_1_4_approved_publication_execution.py
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from uuid import uuid4

import pytest

from app.application.announcements.execution.approved_publication_execution import (
    ApprovedPublicationExecutionService,
)
from app.application.announcements.execution.contracts import (
    PublicationExecutionStatus,
)
from app.domain.announcements.publication import Publication
from app.domain.announcements.template_models import (
    PublicationStatus,
    PublicationType,
)


class FakeDurableExecution:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.calls = []

    async def execute(self, *, publication, request):
        self.calls.append((publication, request))
        return type(
            "Result",
            (),
            {
                "status": PublicationExecutionStatus.SUCCEEDED,
            },
        )()


def make_publication(
    *,
    status: PublicationStatus = PublicationStatus.APPROVED,
) -> Publication:
    return Publication(
        publication_id=str(uuid4()),
        template_id="beta-update",
        template_version=1,
        publication_type=PublicationType.BETA_UPDATE,
        title="Beta update",
        content="Test announcement",
        status=status,
        created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_approved_publication_delegates_to_existing_ws22_service() -> None:
    durable = FakeDurableExecution()
    service = ApprovedPublicationExecutionService(
        durable_execution=durable,
    )

    publication = make_publication()

    result = await service.execute(
        publication=publication,
        actor="admin-test",
        idempotency_key="ws23-1-4-test-key",
        correlation_id="ws23-1-4-correlation",
    )

    assert result.status is PublicationExecutionStatus.SUCCEEDED
    assert len(durable.calls) == 1
    _, request = durable.calls[0]
    assert request.actor == "admin-test"
    assert request.idempotency_key == "ws23-1-4-test-key"
    assert request.correlation_id == "ws23-1-4-correlation"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_non_uuid_publication_id_is_rejected_at_ws22_boundary() -> None:
    durable = FakeDurableExecution()
    service = ApprovedPublicationExecutionService(
        durable_execution=durable,
    )

    publication = Publication(
        publication_id="ws23-publication-001",
        template_id="beta-update",
        template_version=1,
        publication_type=PublicationType.BETA_UPDATE,
        title="Beta update",
        content="Test announcement",
        status=PublicationStatus.APPROVED,
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="Approved publication ID must be a UUID",
    ):
        await service.execute(
            publication=publication,
            actor="admin-test",
            idempotency_key="ws23-1-4-test-key",
            correlation_id="ws23-1-4-correlation",
        )

    assert durable.calls == []


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_non_approved_publication_is_not_sent_directly() -> None:
    durable = FakeDurableExecution()
    service = ApprovedPublicationExecutionService(
        durable_execution=durable,
    )

    publication = make_publication(
        status=PublicationStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL,
    )

    # The integration boundary itself does not bypass WS-22. The canonical
    # durable service remains responsible for enforcing approved-only execution.
    class RejectingDurableExecution:
        async def execute(self, *, publication, request):
            raise ValueError("Only approved publications may be executed.")

    service = ApprovedPublicationExecutionService(
        durable_execution=RejectingDurableExecution(),
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="Only approved publications may be executed",
    ):
        await service.execute(
            publication=publication,
            actor="admin-test",
            idempotency_key="ws23-1-4-test-key",
            correlation_id="ws23-1-4-correlation",
        )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone

import pytest
from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.application.announcement.announcement_composer import (
    AnnouncementComposer,
)
from app.application.announcement.announcement_publisher import (
    ControlledAnnouncementPublisher,
)
from app.api.announcement_controls import (
    create_announcement_router,
)


@dataclass
class FakeTelegramMessage:
    message_id: int


class FakeTelegramClient:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.calls: list[dict] = []

    async def send_message(
        self,
        *,
        chat_id: str,
        text: str,
        parse_mode: str,
    ) -> FakeTelegramMessage:
        self.calls.append(
            {
                "chat_id": chat_id,
                "text": text,
                "parse_mode": parse_mode,
            }
        )

        return FakeTelegramMessage(
            message_id=123,
        )


def create_test_app(
    *,
    client: FakeTelegramClient,
    authorized: bool = True,
    publishing_enabled: bool = True,
) -> FastAPI:
    publisher = ControlledAnnouncementPublisher(
        publisher=_TelegramPublisherDouble(
            client=client,
        ),
        publishing_enabled=publishing_enabled,
    )

    async def authorize_admin() -> bool:
        return authorized

    router = create_announcement_router(
        publisher=publisher,
        composer=AnnouncementComposer(),
        admin_authorizer=authorize_admin,
    )

    app = FastAPI()
    app.include_router(router)

    return app


class _TelegramPublisherDouble:
    """Small test double implementing AnnouncementPublisher."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        client: FakeTelegramClient,
    ) -> None:
        self._client = client

    async def publish(
        self,
        *,
        channel_id: str,
        text: str,
    ) -> str:
        result = await self._client.send_message(
            chat_id=channel_id,
            text=text,
            parse_mode="Markdown",
        )

        return str(result.message_id)


@pytest.fixture
def telegram_client() -> FakeTelegramClient:
    return FakeTelegramClient()


def test_admin_can_publish_announcement(
    telegram_client: FakeTelegramClient,
    monkeypatch,
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setenv(
        "BETA1_ANNOUNCEMENT_CHANNEL_ID",
        "-100123456789",
    )

    app = create_test_app(
        client=telegram_client,
        authorized=True,
    )

    with TestClient(app) as client:
        response = client.post(
            "/admin/announcements/publish",
            json={
                "announcement_type": "maintenance",
                "title": "Planned maintenance",
                "body": "The Academy will be temporarily unavailable.",
                "footer": "We will communicate when service is restored.",
            },
        )

    assert response.status_code == 201

    payload = response.json()

    assert payload["channel_id"] == "-100123456789"
    assert payload["message_id"] == "123"
    assert payload["announcement_type"] == "maintenance"

    assert len(telegram_client.calls) == 1

    published_text = telegram_client.calls[0]["text"]

    assert "ðŸ› ï¸ MAINTENANCE" in published_text
    assert "Planned maintenance" in published_text
    assert "Academy will be temporarily unavailable" in published_text
    assert "EasyWorld" in published_text


def test_non_admin_cannot_publish(
    telegram_client: FakeTelegramClient,
    monkeypatch,
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setenv(
        "BETA1_ANNOUNCEMENT_CHANNEL_ID",
        "-100123456789",
    )

    app = create_test_app(
        client=telegram_client,
        authorized=False,
    )

    with TestClient(app) as client:
        response = client.post(
            "/admin/announcements/publish",
            json={
                "announcement_type": "important",
                "title": "Important update",
                "body": "This must not be published.",
            },
        )

    assert response.status_code == 403
    assert telegram_client.calls == []


def test_publishing_disabled_does_not_call_telegram(
    telegram_client: FakeTelegramClient,
    monkeypatch,
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setenv(
        "BETA1_ANNOUNCEMENT_CHANNEL_ID",
        "-100123456789",
    )

    app = create_test_app(
        client=telegram_client,
        authorized=True,
        publishing_enabled=False,
    )

    with TestClient(app) as client:
        response = client.post(
            "/admin/announcements/publish",
            json={
                "announcement_type": "beta_update",
                "title": "Beta update",
                "body": "Publishing is currently disabled.",
            },
        )

    assert response.status_code == 503
    assert telegram_client.calls == []


def test_invalid_announcement_is_rejected_before_telegram(
    telegram_client: FakeTelegramClient,
    monkeypatch,
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setenv(
        "BETA1_ANNOUNCEMENT_CHANNEL_ID",
        "-100123456789",
    )

    app = create_test_app(
        client=telegram_client,
        authorized=True,
    )

    with TestClient(app) as client:
        response = client.post(
            "/admin/announcements/publish",
            json={
                "announcement_type": "important",
                "title": "",
                "body": "Invalid announcement.",
            },
        )

    assert response.status_code == 422
    assert telegram_client.calls == []


def test_announcement_type_is_validated(
    telegram_client: FakeTelegramClient,
    monkeypatch,
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setenv(
        "BETA1_ANNOUNCEMENT_CHANNEL_ID",
        "-100123456789",

    app = create_test_app(

                "announcement_type": "not_a_real_type",
                "title": "Invalid type",
                "body": "This should not publish.",
            },
        )

    assert response.status_code == 422
    assert telegram_client.calls == []

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from app.application.health.dependency_checks import (
    AsyncDependencyCheck,
    ConfigurationCheck,
)
from app.application.health.operational_event import (
    OperationalEvent,
    OperationalEventType,
    OperationalSeverity,
    OperationalSurface,
)
from app.application.health.operational_event_service import (
    OperationalEventService,
)
from app.application.health.operational_health_snapshot import (
    OperationalHealthSnapshotService,
)
from app.application.health.operational_dashboard_service import (
    OperationalDashboardService,
)
from app.application.health.production_readiness_service import (
    ProductionReadinessService,
)
from app.application.operations_center.announcement_group_operations_api import (
    AnnouncementGroupOperationsAPI,
)


async def healthy_probe():
    return True


def make_api():
    readiness = ProductionReadinessService(
        checks=(
            ConfigurationCheck(
                name="telegram",
                configured=True,
            ),
            AsyncDependencyCheck(
                name="postgresql",
                probe=healthy_probe,
            ),
            AsyncDependencyCheck(
                name="llm_provider",
                probe=healthy_probe,
            ),
        )
    )

    health = OperationalHealthSnapshotService(
        readiness_service=readiness,
    )

    events = OperationalEventService()

    dashboard = OperationalDashboardService(
        health_snapshot_service=health,
        event_service=events,
    )

    api = AnnouncementGroupOperationsAPI(
        dashboard_service=dashboard,
        event_service=events,
    )

    return api, events


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_ws21_18_returns_fresh_announcement_group_snapshot():
    api, _events = make_api()

    first = await api.get_details()
    second = await api.get_details()

    assert first["surface"] == "announcement_group"
    assert first["status"] == "healthy"
    assert first["health_score"] == 100

    assert first["generated_at"] != second["generated_at"]


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_ws21_18_exposes_announcement_incidents_and_events_only():
    api, events = make_api()

    events.record_event(
        OperationalEvent(
            event_type=OperationalEventType.TELEGRAM_FAILURE,
            surface=OperationalSurface.ANNOUNCEMENT_GROUP,
            correlation_id="announcement-001",
            severity=OperationalSeverity.HIGH,
        )
    )

    events.record_event(
        OperationalEvent(
            event_type=OperationalEventType.MESSAGE_FAILURE,
            surface=OperationalSurface.PRIVATE_CLASSROOM,
            correlation_id="private-001",
            severity=OperationalSeverity.HIGH,
        )
    )

    result = await api.get_details()

    assert result["incidents"]["summary"]["total"] == 1

    assert len(result["incidents"]["items"]) == 1

    assert (
        result["incidents"]["items"][0]["surface"]
        == "announcement_group"
    )

    assert len(result["events"]) == 1

    assert (
        result["events"][0]["surface"]
        == "announcement_group"
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_ws21_18_contains_dependency_and_metric_details():
    api, events = make_api()

    events.record_event(
        OperationalEvent(
            event_type=OperationalEventType.TELEGRAM_FAILURE,
            surface=OperationalSurface.ANNOUNCEMENT_GROUP,
            correlation_id="telegram-001",
        )
    )

    events.record_event(
        OperationalEvent(
            event_type=OperationalEventType.RATE_LIMIT,
            surface=OperationalSurface.ANNOUNCEMENT_GROUP,
            correlation_id="rate-001",
        )
    )

    events.record_event(
        OperationalEvent(
            event_type=OperationalEventType.ABUSE,
            surface=OperationalSurface.ANNOUNCEMENT_GROUP,
            correlation_id="abuse-001",
        )
    )

    result = await api.get_details()

    assert {
        item["name"]
        for item in result["dependencies"]
    } == {
        "telegram",
        "postgresql",
        "llm_provider",
    }

    assert result["metrics"] == {
        "message_failures": 0,
        "rate_limit_events": 1,
        "abuse_events": 1,
    }


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_ws21_18_does_not_expose_sensitive_event_metadata():
    api, events = make_api()

    events.record_event(
        OperationalEvent(
            event_type=OperationalEventType.TELEGRAM_FAILURE,
            surface=OperationalSurface.ANNOUNCEMENT_GROUP,
            correlation_id="safe-001",
            metadata={
                "message": "PRIVATE MESSAGE CONTENT",
                "prompt": "PRIVATE PROMPT",
                "response": "PRIVATE AI RESPONSE",
                "api_key": "SECRET",
                "safe_status": "timeout",
            },
        )
    )

    result = await api.get_details()

    payload = str(result).lower()

    assert "private message content" not in payload
    assert "private prompt" not in payload
    assert "private ai response" not in payload
    assert "secret" not in payload

    assert "safe_status" in payload


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_ws21_18_empty_state_is_safe():
    api, _events = make_api()

    result = await api.get_details()

    assert result["incidents"]["summary"]["total"] == 0
    assert result["incidents"]["items"] == []
    assert result["events"] == []


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_ws21_18_preserves_announcement_surface():
    api, events = make_api()

    events.record_event(
        OperationalEvent(
            event_type=OperationalEventType.TELEGRAM_FAILURE,
            surface=OperationalSurface.ANNOUNCEMENT_GROUP,
            correlation_id="announcement-002",
            severity=OperationalSeverity.MEDIUM,
        )
    )

    result = await api.get_details()

    assert result["surface"] == "announcement_group"

    assert all(
        item["surface"] == "announcement_group"
        for item in result["incidents"]["items"]
    )

    assert all(
        event["surface"] == "announcement_group"
        for event in result["events"]
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable
from os import getenv

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.application.announcement.announcement_composer import (
    AnnouncementComposer,
)
from app.application.announcement.announcement_publisher import (
    ControlledAnnouncementPublisher,
    PublicationDisabledError,
)
from app.application.announcement.models import AnnouncementType


class AnnouncementPublishRequest(BaseModel):
    """Administrator request for publishing a Beta announcement."""

    announcement_type: AnnouncementType
    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    body: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=1800)
    footer: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=300)


class AnnouncementPublishResponse(BaseModel):
    """Controlled publication result."""

    channel_id: str
    message_id: str
    announcement_type: str
    published_at: str


AdminAuthorizer = Callable[[], Awaitable[bool]]


async def _default_admin_authorizer() -> bool:
    """
    Fail-closed default administrator authorization.

    Production composition must inject the real administrator
    authorization mechanism.
    """
    return False


def create_announcement_router(
    *,
    publisher: ControlledAnnouncementPublisher,
    composer: AnnouncementComposer | None = None,
    admin_authorizer: AdminAuthorizer = _default_admin_authorizer,
) -> APIRouter:
    """
    Create the WS-02 administrator announcement router.

    The API layer does not:
    - talk directly to Telegram;
    - construct Telegram clients;
    - bypass AnnouncementPolicy;
    - bypass ControlledAnnouncementPublisher;
    - perform autonomous publication.
    """

    if publisher is None:
        raise ValueError("publisher cannot be None.")

    if admin_authorizer is None:
        raise ValueError("admin_authorizer cannot be None.")

    announcement_composer = composer or AnnouncementComposer()

    router = APIRouter(
        prefix="/admin/announcements",
        tags=["admin-announcements"],
    )

    async def require_admin() -> None:
        try:
            authorized = await admin_authorizer()
        except Exception:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
                detail="Administrator authorization required.",
            ) from None

        if not authorized:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
                detail="Administrator authorization required.",
            )

    @router.post(
        "/publish",
        response_model=AnnouncementPublishResponse,
        status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
        dependencies=[Depends(require_admin)],
    )
    async def publish_announcement(
        request: AnnouncementPublishRequest,
    ) -> AnnouncementPublishResponse:
        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        # Composition / policy validation
        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        try:
            composed = announcement_composer.compose(
                announcement_type=request.announcement_type,
                title=request.title,
                body=request.body,
                footer=request.footer,
            )
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                detail=str(exc),
            ) from exc

        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        # Configuration
        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        try:
            channel_id = _resolve_channel_id()
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
                detail=str(exc),
            ) from exc

        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        # Controlled publication
        #
        # PublicationDisabledError is an expected operational state.
        # It is translated here at the HTTP boundary into 503.
        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        try:
            record = await publisher.publish(
                channel_id=channel_id,
                text=composed.rendered_text,
                announcement_type=(
                    composed.announcement.announcement_type.value
                ),
            )
        except PublicationDisabledError:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
                detail="Telegram announcement publishing is disabled.",
            ) from None
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                detail=str(exc),
            ) from exc

        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        # Successful publication
        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        return AnnouncementPublishResponse(
            channel_id=record.channel_id,
            message_id=record.message_id,
            announcement_type=record.announcement_type,
            published_at=record.published_at.isoformat(),
        )

    return router


def _resolve_channel_id() -> str:
    """
    Resolve the Beta 1 announcement channel from configuration.

    The channel ID is deliberately not hard-coded.
    """

    channel_id = getenv(
        "BETA1_ANNOUNCEMENT_CHANNEL_ID",
    )

    if not channel_id:
        raise ValueError(
            "BETA1_ANNOUNCEMENT_CHANNEL_ID is not configured."
        )

    return channel_id


__all__ = [
    "AnnouncementPublishRequest",
    "AnnouncementPublishResponse",
    "create_announcement_router",
]

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.application.announcements.approval.async_approval_service import (
    AsyncAnnouncementPublicationApprovalService,
)


AdminAuthorizer = Callable[[], Awaitable[bool]]


class PublicationApprovalRequest(BaseModel):
    actor: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=255)


class PublicationApprovalResponse(BaseModel):
    publication_id: str
    status: str
    approved_at: str | None


async def _default_admin_authorizer() -> bool:
    return False


def create_announcement_operations_approval_router(
    *,
    approval_service: AsyncAnnouncementPublicationApprovalService,
    admin_authorizer: AdminAuthorizer = _default_admin_authorizer,
) -> APIRouter:
    if approval_service is None:
        raise ValueError("approval_service cannot be None.")
    if admin_authorizer is None:
        raise ValueError("admin_authorizer cannot be None.")

    router = APIRouter(
        prefix="/api/announcement-operations",
        tags=["announcement-operations"],
    )

    async def require_admin() -> None:
        try:
            authorized = await admin_authorizer()
        except Exception:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
                detail="Administrator authorization required.",
            ) from None

        if not authorized:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
                detail="Administrator authorization required.",
            )

    @router.post(
        "/publications/{publication_id}/approve",
        response_model=PublicationApprovalResponse,
        status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK,
        dependencies=[Depends(require_admin)],
    )
    async def approve_publication(
        publication_id: str,
        request: PublicationApprovalRequest,
    ) -> PublicationApprovalResponse:
        try:
            result = await approval_service.approve(
                publication_id=publication_id,
                actor=request.actor,
            )
        except LookupError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
                detail=str(exc),
            ) from exc
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                detail=str(exc),
            ) from exc

        publication = result.publication
        return PublicationApprovalResponse(
            publication_id=publication.publication_id,
            status=publication.status.value,
            approved_at=(
                publication.approved_at.isoformat()
                if publication.approved_at is not None
                else None
            ),
        )

    return router


__all__ = [
    "AdminAuthorizer",
    "PublicationApprovalRequest",
    "PublicationApprovalResponse",
    "create_announcement_operations_approval_router",
]

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict
from typing import Any
from uuid import uuid4

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.application.announcements.template_editor_service import (
    AnnouncementTemplateEditorService,
)


class PreviewRequest(BaseModel):
    template_id: str
    template_version: int | None = None
    values: dict[str, str] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class CreateDraftRequest(BaseModel):
    publication_id: str | None = None
    template_id: str
    template_version: int | None = None
    title: str
    values: dict[str, str] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def create_template_editor_router(
    service: AnnouncementTemplateEditorService,
) -> APIRouter:
    """Create the HTTP adapter for the template-driven editor.

    Composition owns the service. This router never creates repositories,
    providers, Telegram clients, or publication executors.
    """

    if service is None:
        raise ValueError("service cannot be None.")

    router = APIRouter(
        prefix="/api/announcement-operations/template-editor",
        tags=["announcement-operations"],
    )

    @router.get("/templates")
    def list_templates() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return [asdict(item) for item in service.list_approved_templates()]

    @router.post("/preview")
    def preview(request: PreviewRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
        try:
            result = service.preview(
                template_id=request.template_id,
                values=request.values,
                version=request.template_version,
            )
        except (LookupError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc

        return asdict(result)

    @router.post("/drafts")
    def create_draft(request: CreateDraftRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
        try:
            publication = service.create_draft(
                publication_id=request.publication_id or str(uuid4()),
                template_id=request.template_id,
                title=request.title,
                values=request.values,
                version=request.template_version,
            )
        except (LookupError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc

        return {
            "id": publication.publication_id,
            "title": publication.title,
            "content": publication.content,
            "template_id": publication.template_id,
            "template_version": publication.template_version,
            "publication_type": publication.publication_type.value,
            "status": publication.status.value,
            "created_at": publication.created_at.isoformat()
            if publication.created_at
            else None,
        }

    return router

def _required_environment(name: str) -> str:
    value = os.getenv(name, "").strip()

    if not value:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"{name} is required for authentication email composition."
        )

    return value


def _create_announcement_components():
    telegram_client = TelegramAnnouncementClient()

    announcement_publisher = TelegramAnnouncementPublisher(
        telegram_client=telegram_client,
    )

    return (
        telegram_client,
        announcement_publisher,
    )


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(
    application: FastAPI,
):
    scheduler_runtime = application.state.scheduler_runtime

    try:
        await scheduler_runtime.start()
    except Exception as exc:
        print(
            "Cybersecurity scheduler startup failed:",
            exc,
        )

    yield

    try:
        await scheduler_runtime.stop()
    except Exception as exc:
        print(
            "Cybersecurity scheduler shutdown failed:",
            exc,
        )
    finally:
        telegram_client = getattr(
            application.state,
            "announcement_telegram_client",
            None,
        )

        if telegram_client is not None:
            try:
                await telegram_client.close()
            except Exception as exc:
                print(
                    "Telegram announcement client shutdown failed:",
                    exc,
                )

        auth_engine = getattr(
            application.state,
            "auth_engine",
            None,
        )

        if auth_engine is not None:
            try:
                await auth_engine.dispose()
            except Exception as exc:
                print(
                    "PostgreSQL authentication engine shutdown failed:",
                    exc,
                )

        provider_usage_engine = getattr(
            application.state,
            "provider_usage_engine",
            None,
        )

        if provider_usage_engine is not None:
            try:
                provider_usage_engine.dispose()
            except Exception as exc:
                print(
                    "PostgreSQL provider-usage engine shutdown failed:",
                    exc,
                )


def create_application() -> FastAPI:
    academy_config = (
        AcademyActivationConfig.from_environment()
    )

    auth_engine = create_async_database_engine()

    auth_session_factory = (
        create_async_session_factory(
            auth_engine,
        )
    )

    auth_repository = (
        PostgreSQLAuthenticationRepository(
            auth_session_factory,
        )
    )

    email_provider_manager = EmailProviderManager()

    authentication_email_sender = AuthenticationEmailSenderAdapter(
        provider_manager=email_provider_manager,
    )

    authentication_email_service = AuthenticationEmailService(
        authentication_email_sender,
        frontend_base_url=_required_environment(
            "EASYCHATBOT_PORTAL_URL"
        ),
    )

    authentication_service = AuthenticationService(
        auth_repository,
        email_service=authentication_email_service,
    )

    # Provider-usage repository is synchronous by
    # contract. It therefore receives a synchronous
    # engine/session factory.
    #
    # It must not receive the async authentication
    # session factory.
    provider_usage_engine = (
        create_database_engine()
    )

    persistence_diagnostics_service = PersistenceDiagnosticsService(
        metadata=Base.metadata,
        project_root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1],
        engine=provider_usage_engine,
    )

    provider_usage_session_factory = (
        create_session_factory(
            provider_usage_engine,
        )
    )

    provider_usage_repository = (
        PostgreSQLProviderUsageRepository(
            provider_usage_session_factory,
        )
    )

    provider_usage_dashboard_service = (
        ProviderUsageDashboardService(
            repository=provider_usage_repository,
        )
    )

    functionality_control_repository = (

FILE: frontend\app\components\operations-center\announcement-operations\TemplateDrivenPublicationEditor.tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  createTemplateDraft,
  getEditorTemplates,
  previewTemplate,
  type TemplateEditorOption,
} from "@/app/lib/api/announcementTemplateEditor";

export default function TemplateDrivenPublicationEditor() {
  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState<TemplateEditorOption[]>([]);
  const [templateId, setTemplateId] = useState("");
  const [values, setValues] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState("");
  const [loadingTemplates, setLoadingTemplates] = useState(true);
  const [previewing, setPreviewing] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const selectedTemplate = useMemo(
    () => templates.find((item) => item.template_id === templateId) ?? null,
    [templateId, templates],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    getEditorTemplates()
      .then((items) => {
        setTemplates(items);
        if (items.length > 0) {
          setTemplateId(items[0].template_id);
        }
      })
      .catch((reason: unknown) => {
        setError(
          reason instanceof Error
            ? reason.message
            : "Announcement types could not be loaded.",
        );
      })
      .finally(() => setLoadingTemplates(false));
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedTemplate) {
      setValues({});
      setPreview("");
      return;
    }

    const nextValues: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const field of selectedTemplate.fields) {
      nextValues[field.name] = "";
    }

    setValues(nextValues);
    setPreview("");
    setError(null);
  }, [selectedTemplate]);

  const requiredFieldsMissing = selectedTemplate
    ? selectedTemplate.fields.some(
        (field) => field.required && !values[field.name]?.trim(),
      )
    : true;

  const canPreview =
    Boolean(selectedTemplate) &&
    Boolean(title.trim()) &&
    !requiredFieldsMissing;

  function updateValue(name: string, value: string) {
    setValues((current) => ({ ...current, [name]: value }));
    setMessage(null);
  }

  async function handlePreview() {
    if (!selectedTemplate || !canPreview) {
      return;
    }

    setPreviewing(true);
    setError(null);
    setMessage(null);

    try {
      const result = await previewTemplate({
        templateId: selectedTemplate.template_id,
        templateVersion: selectedTemplate.version,
        values,
      });
      setPreview(result.content);
    } catch (reason: unknown) {
      setError(
        reason instanceof Error
          ? reason.message
          : "Preview could not be generated.",
      );
    } finally {
      setPreviewing(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleSaveDraft() {
    if (!selectedTemplate || !canPreview) {
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);
    setError(null);
    setMessage(null);

    try {
      const result = await createTemplateDraft({
        templateId: selectedTemplate.template_id,
        templateVersion: selectedTemplate.version,
        title: title.trim(),
        values,
      });

      setMessage(
        `Draft ${result.id} saved from ${result.template_id} v${result.template_version}.`,
      );
    } catch (reason: unknown) {
      setError(
        reason instanceof Error
          ? reason.message
          : "The draft could not be saved.",
      );
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-full p-6 lg:p-10">
      <div className="mb-8">
        <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-fuchsia-300">
          Announcement Operations
        </p>
        <h1 className="mt-2 text-3xl font-bold text-white">
          Create publication
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-400">
          Select an approved announcement type, complete its controlled fields,
          preview it, and save a draft.
        </p>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div
          role="alert"
          className="mb-6 rounded-2xl border border-rose-500/30 bg-rose-500/10 p-4 text-sm text-rose-200"
        >
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {message && (
        <div className="mb-6 rounded-2xl border border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/10 p-4 text-sm text-emerald-200">
          {message}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid gap-6 xl:grid-cols-2">
        <section className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/70 p-6">
          <h2 className="font-semibold text-white">Publication content</h2>

          <label
            htmlFor="announcement-type"
            className="mt-5 block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500"
          >
            Announcement type
          </label>

          <select
            id="announcement-type"
            aria-label="Announcement type"
            value={templateId}
            disabled={loadingTemplates || templates.length === 0}
            onChange={(event) => setTemplateId(event.target.value)}
            className="mt-2 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-white outline-none focus:border-fuchsia-500 disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {loadingTemplates && (
              <option value="">Loading announcement typesâ€¦</option>
            )}
            {!loadingTemplates && templates.length === 0 && (
              <option value="">No announcement types available</option>
            )}
            {templates.map((template) => (
              <option key={template.template_id} value={template.template_id}>
                {template.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>

          {selectedTemplate && (
            <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/60 p-4">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <span className="rounded-full bg-fuchsia-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-fuchsia-300">
                  {selectedTemplate.category}
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Approved version {selectedTemplate.version}
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-400">
                {selectedTemplate.description}
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          <label
            htmlFor="announcement-title"
            className="mt-5 block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500"
          >
            Publication title
          </label>
          <input
            id="announcement-title"
            value={title}
            onChange={(event) => setTitle(event.target.value)}
            className="mt-2 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-white outline-none focus:border-fuchsia-500"
            placeholder="Announcement title"
          />

          {selectedTemplate?.fields.map((field) => (
            <div key={field.name}>
              <label
                htmlFor={`template-field-${field.name}`}
                className="mt-5 block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500"
              >
                {field.label}
                {field.required && (
                  <span className="ml-1 text-fuchsia-300">*</span>
                )}
              </label>

              {field.multiline ? (
                <textarea
                  id={`template-field-${field.name}`}
                  value={values[field.name] ?? ""}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateValue(field.name, event.target.value)
                  }
                  rows={5}
                  className="mt-2 w-full resize-y rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-white outline-none focus:border-fuchsia-500"
                />
              ) : (
                <input
                  id={`template-field-${field.name}`}
                  value={values[field.name] ?? ""}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateValue(field.name, event.target.value)
                  }
                  className="mt-2 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-white outline-none focus:border-fuchsia-500"
                />
              )}
            </div>
          ))}

          {selectedTemplate && requiredFieldsMissing && (
            <p className="mt-4 text-xs text-amber-300">
              Complete all required fields before previewing or saving.
            </p>
          )}

          <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={!canPreview || previewing}
              onClick={handlePreview}
              className="rounded-xl border border-fuchsia-500/50 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-fuchsia-200 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
            >
              {previewing ? "Previewingâ€¦" : "Preview"}
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={!canPreview || saving}
              onClick={handleSaveDraft}
              className="rounded-xl bg-fuchsia-500 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
            >
              {saving ? "Savingâ€¦" : "Save draft"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/70 p-6">
          <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-fuchsia-300">
            Preview
          </p>

          <div className="mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 bg-[#050816] p-6">
            <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
              EasyChatBot Academy
            </p>
            <h2 className="mt-3 text-2xl font-bold text-white">
              {title || "Announcement title"}
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-4 whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm leading-7 text-slate-300">
              {preview ||
                "Complete the selected announcement type and choose Preview to see the rendered announcement."}
            </p>
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

FILE: frontend\app\lib\api\announcementTemplateEditor.ts
export interface TemplateEditorField {
  name: string;
  required: boolean;
  label: string;
  multiline: boolean;
}

export interface TemplateEditorOption {
  template_id: string;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  description: string;
  version: number;
  publication_type: string;
  fields: TemplateEditorField[];
}

export interface TemplateEditorPreview {
  template_id: string;
  template_version: number;
  publication_type: string;
  content: string;
}

export interface CreatedDraftPublication {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  content: string;
  template_id: string;
  template_version: number;
  publication_type: string;
  status: string;
  created_at: string | null;
}

const API_BASE =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL ?? "http://localhost:8000";

async function request<T>(
  path: string,
  init?: RequestInit,
): Promise<T> {
  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, {
    ...init,
    headers: {
      Accept: "application/json",
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      ...(init?.headers ?? {}),
    },
    cache: "no-store",
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    let detail = `Announcement template API returned ${response.status}.`;

    try {
      const body = (await response.json()) as { detail?: string };
      if (body.detail) {
        detail = body.detail;
      }
    } catch {
      // Preserve the stable HTTP error for non-JSON responses.
    }

    throw new Error(detail);
  }

  return response.json() as Promise<T>;
}

export function getEditorTemplates(): Promise<TemplateEditorOption[]> {
  return request<TemplateEditorOption[]>(
    "/api/announcement-operations/template-editor/templates",
  );
}

export function previewTemplate(input: {
  templateId: string;
  templateVersion: number;
  values: Record<string, string>;
}): Promise<TemplateEditorPreview> {
  return request<TemplateEditorPreview>(
    "/api/announcement-operations/template-editor/preview",
    {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({
        template_id: input.templateId,
        template_version: input.templateVersion,
        values: input.values,
      }),
    },
  );
}

export function createTemplateDraft(input: {
  templateId: string;
  templateVersion: number;
  title: string;
  values: Record<string, string>;
}): Promise<CreatedDraftPublication> {
  return request<CreatedDraftPublication>(
    "/api/announcement-operations/template-editor/drafts",
    {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({
        template_id: input.templateId,
        template_version: input.templateVersion,
        title: input.title,
        values: input.values,
      }),
    },
  );
}
